column1: # Bastard Bonds phase 2 (dialogue and map scripts)
Simple enough.
column2: 简单得很。

column1: Your day is about to end badly.
column2: 你今天要倒霉收场了。

column1: Shall we see what purpose this serves?
column2: 要不要看看这是做什么用的？

column1: I wonder what that could be for.
column2: 不知道那会是做什么用的。

column1: You'll pay for that!
column2: 你会为此付出代价！

column1: No!
column2: 不！

column1: I thought I heard something.\nJust my imagination, perhaps.
column2: 我好像听见了什么。\n也许只是我的错觉。

column1: I'm quite ready to be rid of this place, I think.
column2: 我想，我已经很想离开这地方了。

column1: Today is an excellent day to die!
column2: 今天是去死的好日子！

column1: Well, it's been good working with you.
column2: 嗯，跟你们共事还挺愉快的。

column1: Nonsense!\nFocus, and we shall take them down!
column2: 胡说！\n集中精神，我们就能打倒他们！

column1: I won't hear that talk!\nWe'll win if we work together!
column2: 我不想听这种话！\n齐心协力，我们就能赢！

column1: Perhaps our chances would\nimprove without your attitude.
column2: 没了你这态度，\n我们的胜算或许还能高些。

column1: Still your tongue, fool!
column2: 管住你的舌头，蠢货！

column1: It was bound to happen like this.
column2: 早晚会变成这样。

column1: Well, what did you expect?
column2: 那你还指望什么？

column1: It looks like we have enough to last us for a little while now. Good news to be sure, but we mustn't rest on our laurels just yet. Those supplies won't last forever, and I assume this place is temporary at best.
column2: 看起来我们眼下的存货够撑上一阵子了。这当然是好消息，可还不能就此松懈。那些补给总有耗尽的时候，而且我猜这地方最多也只是临时落脚。

column1: Hmm? I thought we had a decent arrangement. You want me to go?
column2: 嗯？我还以为我们相处得不错。你要我走？

column1: Good to see you. How goes it?
column2: 见到你真好。近来如何？

column1: Hmm. Well alright, I'll stay. If you need anything from me, just say so.
column2: 嗯。那好吧，我留下。需要我做什么，尽管说。

column1: I see. Well I'll be off then.
column2: 明白了。那我这就走。

column1: I cannot beat you!
column2: 我打不过你！

column1: Then I'll only face death at the hands of the next bastard who comes along! No deal!
column2: 那我不过是死在下一个找上门的混蛋手里！没得谈！

column1: I can't die over this. Take it and let me be!
column2: 我不能为这东西送命。拿走，放我走！

column1: I could never follow someone like you!
column2: 我绝不可能追随你这种人！

column1: It's preferable to death I suppose. Fine, I am yours.
column2: 总比死了强，我想。好，我归你了。

column1: Very well.
column2: 那好吧。

column1: Well then, let's be off!
column2: 那就出发吧！

column1: I came here for much the same reason as you, no doubt, looking for supplies. I haven't found much yet, but I'm going to rest up and take it slow. I was nearly had by a monster back there, so I don't want to push it.
column2: 我来这儿的理由想必跟你差不多，就是找补给。眼下还没找到多少，我打算先歇一歇，慢慢来。刚才差点栽在一头怪物手里，不想再硬闯了。

column1: This place is dangerous. Be on your guard.
column2: 这地方很危险。保持警惕。

column1: Now there's an idea. Many hands make light work as they say. Shall we?
column2: 这主意不错。都说人多好办事。要一起吗？

column1: I understand your reticence, and will not force the issue. Take care.
column2: 我理解你的顾虑，不会强求。保重。

column1: There's nothing quite like warming your bones by the fire, eh? After what we've been through, I'm lucky to have the chance. You know, I don't think I'd have made it this far without you backing me up, so thanks for that. Whatever happens from here on out, I just wanted you to know that you can count on me. Here's a little something as a show of faith.
column2: 没有什么比在火边暖暖骨头更舒服了，对吧？经历过这些，我还能有这个机会，已经算走运。你知道，要不是你一直支持我，我想我走不到今天，所以谢谢你。往后无论怎样，我只想让你知道，你可以依靠我。这点小东西，算是一点诚意。

column1: Taking a break before the next run? Everybody's counting on you, so don't push yourself too hard. If you need me to help you with anything, just ask, and I'll be ready.
column2: 再次出发前先歇歇？大家都指望着你，别把自己逼得太紧。有什么要我帮忙的，尽管开口，我随时都准备好。

column1: You mean for me to leave permanently, don't you?
column2: 你是要我永久离开，对吧？

column1: How are you? Everything's fine here.
column2: 你怎么样？这边一切都好。

column1: Is something the matter? If there's a problem, think it through and don't do something you might regret.
column2: 出什么事了吗？要是有问题，想清楚，别做出会后悔的事。

column1: I had hoped to be useful, but I guess I didn't work hard enough. Good luck.
column2: 我本希望能派上用场，看来是还不够努力。祝你好运。

column1: Great, I could use a little exercise!
column2: 好极了，我正想活动活动！

column1: Alright, who's first?
column2: 行，谁先来？

column1: Someone go see what that is.
column2: 谁去看看那是什么。

column1: You see that?
column2: 你看见了吗？

column1: You're next,  asshole!
column2: 下一个就是你，混蛋！

column1: Oh, fuck you!
column2: 去你妈的！

column1: This place is starting to get to me.\nCan we finish up?
column2: 这地方开始让我心烦了。\n能赶紧了结吗？

column1: We have a good reason for being here, right?
column2: 我们来这儿是有正当理由的，对吧？

column1: Shit! They're too much!
column2: 操！他们太强了！

column1: Time to go down swinging!
column2: 那就打到最后一口气了！

column1: Just let me take care of it!
column2: 交给我来搞定！

column1: No way! Just watch me!
column2: 没门！看好了！

column1: Either shut up and help or\nget out of the damn way!
column2: 要么闭嘴帮忙，\n要么给老子滚开！

column1: Ugh, I'm sick of your damn whinging!
column2: 呃，你这该死的抱怨我听够了！

column1: Saves me the trouble, I guess.
column2: 倒省得我动手了。

column1: Fuck. Whatever.
column2: 操。随便吧。

column1: So it's not quite the comforts of city life, but it has its charms. I get to crack heads whenever someone pisses me off, and no guards come running. Still, it's been a long while since I had a good drink. I wonder if we'll ever get off this shitpile island.
column2: 虽说比不上城里那些舒服日子，可也有它的好处。谁惹我就砸谁的脑袋，也没有卫兵冲过来。不过，我好久没好好喝上一杯了。不知道我们还能不能离开这座屎堆岛。

column1: You want me to leave? After all that twisting my arm to get me here in the first place?
column2: 你要我走？当初可是你拧着我的胳膊把我弄来的。

column1: Nothing to report here.
column2: 这边没什么可说的。

column1: Then why the hell are we talking about it?
column2: 那我们他妈还说这个干什么？

column1: Fine. I had you figured for a coward anyway.
column2: 行。我早就觉得你是个懦夫。

column1: Damn you! If you're going to put me down then do it already!
column2: 该死的！要干掉我就赶紧动手！

column1: You're gonna have to pry it from my cold, dead fingers, asshole!
column2: 想拿走就从我冰冷的死手里抠，混蛋！

column1: Take it then, and fuck off!
column2: 那就拿走，滚蛋！

column1: Fuck you, I'd rather die!
column2: 去你妈的，我宁可死！

column1: Well, you kicked my ass pretty good, so I guess I don't have much choice. Let's go.
column2: 行，你把我揍得够惨的，看来我也没多少选择。走吧。

column1: Ah shit. I'm in no position to argue. I hope something else in here eats you.
column2: 啊，操。我也没资格争。希望这儿有别的东西把你吃了。

column1: Wait, you're actually serious? If you think you can actually score me some liquor and ass, sure, I'll tag along for a bit. Let's see where this goes.
column2: 等等，你是认真的？你要是真能给我搞到酒和屁股，行，我就跟你走一阵。看看能走到哪儿。

column1: Look, if you don't have some business with me you'd better get lost. And if your business is pissing me off, well... you're going to be real sorry you found me.
column2: 听着，跟我没什么事就最好滚开。你要是来气我……那你可要后悔撞上我。

column1: What the hell do you want?
column2: 你他妈想干什么？

column1: Hah! You want me to join you? Sure, just hook me up with some liquor and a decent ass or two and we got a deal!
column2: 哈！你要我加入？行啊，给我搞点酒，再来一两个像样的屁股，就成交！

column1: Like I said, get lost.
column2: 我说了，滚开。

column1: You know, back when I agreed to follow you, I never thought it would be like this. I eat better, and I sleep better since being with you. We got a thing that works, you know? Anyway, I just wanted to let you know that I think you're alright, and I'm more comfortable when I have you at my back. Thanks.
column2: 你知道，当初答应跟着你的时候，我可没想到会是这样。跟着你以后，我吃得更好，睡得也更好。咱们这套挺管用的，知道吧？总之，我就想让你知道，我觉得你这人不错，有你在背后我更踏实。谢了。

column1: There was some ruckus a little earlier, but I sat 'em down and shut 'em up. Someone has to, right? Naw, I didn't hurt 'em, don't worry. They might be a bunch of scum, but they're the only crew we got in this place, and broken bones are no good for anyone when shit goes down. Anyway, did you need something?
column2: 刚才闹了一阵，我把他们按坐下，让他们闭上了嘴。总得有人干这事，对吧？没有，我没伤着他们，别担心。他们也许是一帮人渣，可这地方就这一支团伙，真出事的时候，骨头断了对谁都没好处。总之，你有什么事吗？

column1: You gotta be shitting me. After all that, you want me to just fuck off?
column2: 你他妈逗我呢。经历了这么多，你就让我滚蛋？

column1: Hey there. All's well here.
column2: 嘿。这边都好。

column1: If that was supposed to be a joke, it wasn't fucking funny.
column2: 这要是个笑话，可一点都他妈不好笑。

column1: Well, fuck you too. You'd better hope I never see you again.
column2: 行，也去你妈的。你最好祈祷别再让我看见你。

column1: Must we truly bother with this rabble?
column2: 我们真有必要跟这帮乌合之众费事吗？

column1: You distract us from matters of greater import.\nBegone.
column2: 你们妨碍我们处理更要紧的事。\n退去。

column1: That appears to be of some importance.
column2: 那东西看来有些要紧。

column1: A curiosity.
column2: 真稀奇。

column1: Your vengeance comes hence!
column2: 复仇就此降临！

column1: Your death draws nigh, dog!
column2: 你的死期已近，狗东西！

column1: Such charming decor.
column2: 这装潢可真迷人。

column1: Is it really necessary for us to linger here?
column2: 我们真有必要在这儿磨蹭吗？

column1: You fool! You've led us to our demise!
column2: 蠢货！你把我们带上了死路！

column1: Now we'll all die like vermin thanks to you!
column2: 这下我们都要像害虫一样死去，都怪你！

column1: Fear not. I will lead us to victory!
column2: 不必害怕。我将带领我们走向胜利！

column1: I'll brook no such dissent. Focus!
column2: 这种异议，我绝不容。集中精神！

column1: Of course a fool like you would say as much.
column2: 像你这样的蠢货，当然会这么说。

column1: Is battle too grand a scheme for your simple mind?
column2: 战斗这等大计，你那简单的脑子装得下吗？

column1: Predictable.
column2: 不出所料。

column1: Well, that's convenient.
column2: 嗯，倒也省事。

column1: Is this hovel really the best we can manage? Surely there's something a bit less damp we could be using instead? Something a bit less infested with vermin?
column2: 这破屋子真是我们能弄到的最好去处？总该有个不这么潮湿的地方能用吧？害虫不这么多的也行？

column1: Are you suggesting that you'll be better off without me?
column2: 你是说没有我会更好？

column1: Oh, it's you. I assume you have a reason for bothering me?
column2: 哦，是你。我猜你来烦我总有个理由吧？

column1: Of course you wouldn't. Now don't talk such rot.
column2: 你当然不会。别再说这种胡话了。

column1: Honestly, it's a relief. I can scarcely stand the sight of you anymore.
column2: 说实话，这倒是种解脱。我几乎再也不想看见你。

column1: I am brought down by the likes of you? Ugh.
column2: 我竟栽在你这种人手里？呃。

column1: A common criminal to the last. Go to hell!
column2: 彻头彻尾的下贱罪犯。下地狱去吧！

column1: I should have guessed a wretch like you would care for naught but wealth. Take it and be satisfied.
column2: 我早该猜到，你这种废物除了钱财什么都不在乎。拿走，满意了吧。

column1: Submit to servitude? Never! You'll have to kill me!
column2: 屈身为奴？绝不！你得先杀了我！

column1: Is this my fate? Toiling 'neath the boot of a thug? I have no resistance left. I am yours.
column2: 这就是我的命运？在一个恶棍的靴底下卖命？我已经无力反抗。我归你了。

column1: You'll wish you'd saved your pity for yourself.
column2: 你会后悔没把这份怜悯留给自己。

column1: Well then, let's see if we can't keep from irritating one another to death, hmm? Lead the way.
column2: 那就看看我们能不能别把彼此烦死，嗯？带路吧。

column1: Well, at least you're smart enough not to draw weapons on me. It isn't much, but it's more than I expected. \nWhat is it that you want?
column2: 至少你还算聪明，没对我拔武器。这算不了什么，可比我预料的强。\n你究竟想要什么？

column1: Keep away from me, criminal.
column2: 离我远点，罪犯。

column1: Though I may well retch at the thought of walking abreast rabble, I admit I am short on allies. Perhaps we can help one another.
column2: 虽说一想到与乌合之众并肩，我几乎要作呕，可我也承认盟友不足。或许我们可以彼此帮衬。

column1: On second thought, you're right, that would be most unbearable. Now, toddle off.
column2: 再一想，你说得对，那实在难以忍受。现在，乖乖走开吧。

column1: When you pressed me into service way back when, I admit I had you figured for a common rogue. I must say I entirely underestimated your competence, and I am most pleased at the surprise. It is only proper that I should present you with this as a congratulatory token. You have earned it.
column2: 当初你强迫我效力的时候，我承认把你当成了寻常流氓。我必须说，我完全低估了你的本事，这份惊喜令我十分高兴。把这个作为贺礼送给你，才算得体。这是你应得的。

column1: If anything, it's a small wonder you've managed to hold this rabble together. Honestly, it's no wonder you want me around, surrounded with the worst sort such as you are, but we make the most of what's available, hmm?
column2: 说起来，你能把这帮乌合之众拢住，已经是小小的奇迹了。说实话，你身边尽是最差劲的货色，难怪你想把我留在身边。不过，有什么我们就用什么吧，嗯？

column1: That's preposterous! This lot will crumble without me. Are you serious?
column2: 荒谬！没有我，这帮人马上就会散。你是认真的？

column1: Good day. Are you here to discuss business?
column2: 日安。你是来谈正事的？

column1: Well of course not. Surely you aren't so grand a fool.
column2: 那当然不会。你总不至于蠢到那个份上。

column1: Don't doubt for a moment that they'll all turn on you as soon as the last bastion of civility is gone. Mark my words.
column2: 别有丝毫怀疑，一旦最后那点体面不在了，他们全都会反咬你。记住我的话。

column1: To battle!
column2: 开战！

column1: Victory awaits!
column2: 胜利正等着我们！

column1: I wonder what purpose that serves.
column2: 不知道那是做什么用的。

column1: Shall we take a look?
column2: 我们去看看？

column1: You will be avenged!
column2: 我会为你报仇！

column1: Come and meet your end, knave!
column2: 过来领死吧，无赖！

column1: Everything looks fine here, for now.
column2: 眼下看来，这边一切都好。

column1: Do you think there is anything to find here?
column2: 你觉得这儿能找到什么吗？

column1: This may be our last battle.
column2: 这或许是我们的最后一战。

column1: Run! I'll hold them off!
column2: 快跑！我来拦住他们！

column1: You're being dramatic.\nWe will persevere!
column2: 你太夸张了。\n我们会挺过去的！

column1: You overestimate their strength.\nFear not!
column2: 你高估了他们的力量。\n不必害怕！

column1: Don't be such a fool.\nWe're stronger than you believe!
column2: 别这么蠢。\n我们比你以为的更强！

column1: Lay down and die if it suits you.\nI'll do no such thing!
column2: 你想躺下等死就随你。\n我才不会！

column1: Such strength!
column2: 好强的力量！

column1: An impressive adversary!
column2: 真是了不起的对手！

column1: We've actually got something halfway civil here, haven't we? It's inspiring, really, to see the outcasts of society coming together like this. I'm pleased to be a part of it!
column2: 我们这儿总算有几分体面了，对吧？看到被社会抛弃的人这样聚到一起，真让人振奋。我很高兴能成为其中一员！

column1: You mean to have me quit the group for good, is that it?
column2: 你是要我彻底退出这团伙，是吗？

column1: A fine day to you.
column2: 你好，今天是个好日子。

column1: I am relieved! Is there some issue at hand I could help with?
column2: 我松了口气！眼下有什么事我能帮忙吗？

column1: Well, I'm disappointed but I'm sure you have your reasons. Take care of everyone, and farewell.
column2: 嗯，我很失望，但我相信你有你的理由。照顾好大家，再会。

column1: I yield! Mercy!
column2: 我投降！饶命！

column1: I won't be robbed like some hapless fool!
column2: 我不会像个倒霉的蠢货那样任人抢劫！

column1: No possession is worth death. Take it and let me walk!
column2: 没有什么财物值得赔上性命。拿走，放我走！

column1: Never! I won't give you the satisfaction!
column2: 绝不！我不会让你称心！

column1: My pride or my life then? Very well. I will join you.
column2: 那就是要我在自尊和性命之间选？好吧。我加入你。

column1: I will go immediately.
column2: 我这就走。

column1: Marvellous! I shall follow your lead then.
column2: 好极了！那我就追随你。

column1: Be careful of the lurking beasts. I've scarce set foot anywhere on this island without being harried by them. Worse yet, some places are holdouts for bandits, or trapped ruins. I am taking a moment here to assess my options before venturing further.
column2: 小心那些潜伏的野兽。这岛上我几乎走到哪儿都被它们追着骚扰。更糟的是，有些地方是强盗盘踞之处，或者布了陷阱的废墟。我在这儿停一停，先权衡一下，再继续往前。

column1: Well-met stranger.
column2: 幸会，陌生人。

column1: You know, I was thinking just the same thing. Share in the toil, share in the spoils! What say you?
column2: 你知道，我也正这么想。同担劳苦，同享收获！你意下如何？

column1: That is a shame, but I understand. It is difficult to trust anyone here.
column2: 真可惜，但我理解。在这儿很难信任任何人。

column1: You know, when I ended up here, I was certain that it was me against a horde, and there would be no companionship to be had. I am quite pleased to see that I was wrong on that. We are managing to make the best of a hopeless situation, bringing comfort and hope to the lost, and working with you in this has truly been a privilege. Take this, as a token of my esteem, and know that I gladly call you friend.
column2: 你知道，当初落到这儿时，我认定是自己一人对抗一大群人，不会有什么同伴。我很高兴自己错了。我们正在把无望的处境尽量过好，给迷失的人带来安慰与希望，能与你一同做这件事，真是我的荣幸。收下这个，当作我敬意的信物，也请知道，我乐意称你为朋友。

column1: If we carry on the way things have been going, we'll have a proper community before long! With homes and shops and the whole lot. I wonder if we would be able to find a decent site for such a thing? Nevermind me though, I'm getting ahead of myself. What's on your mind?
column2: 照现在这样下去，我们很快就会有一个像样的聚居地！有房屋，有店铺，样样齐全。不知道能不能找到一块合适的地方？别管我，我想得太远了。你在想什么？

column1: What? I thought we were friends. Is this really what you want?
column2: 什么？我还以为我们是朋友。你真的想这样吗？

column1: It's always a pleasure to see you.
column2: 见到你总是件乐事。

column1: If something is wrong, I will help you through it. Please trust me.
column2: 要是出了什么事，我会帮你撑过去。请相信我。

column1: I'll go then. It's been my pleasure to work alongside you, and I wish you all the best.
column2: 那我走了。能与你共事是我的荣幸，祝你一切顺利。

column1: A death for you,\nand one for you!
column2: 一份死给你，\n再来一份给你！

column1: Now to paint the floor in pretty red.
column2: 现在把地板涂成漂亮的红。

column1: It doesn't do anything if we nothing do.
column2: 我们要是什么都不做，它就什么都不做。

column1: It says "touch me like you touch your lover".
column2: 它说“像你抚摸情人那样抚摸我”。

column1: Such a pretty sleep.
column2: 多么漂亮的一觉。

column1: Breaking the thread is not allowed!
column2: 不许扯断这根线！

column1: Tick, tock, tick, tock...
column2: 嘀，嗒，嘀，嗒……

column1: One plus one is me, me plus you is two,\nyou plus two is three...
column2: 一加一是我，我加你是二，\n你加二是三……

column1: The thread winds short.\nTime's up!
column2: 线快绕完了。\n时间到了！

column1: Yes, make the voices stop!\nMake everything stop!
column2: 对，让那些声音停下来！\n让一切都停下来！

column1: So beautiful when you are wrong.
column2: 你错的时候真美。

column1: You are funny.\nI won't let them cut the thread!
column2: 你真有趣。\n我不会让他们剪断线！

column1: Stop screeching your stupid words!
column2: 别再尖叫你那些蠢话！

column1: A fistful of thread still, see?\nWind it 'round their necks, and yours too!
column2: 手里还剩一把线，看见了吗？\n绕上他们的脖子，也绕上你的！

column1: Take your stupid face and get in the ground!
column2: 带着你那张蠢脸，滚进土里去！

column1: Haha! Never come back!
column2: 哈哈！永远别回来！

column1: No matter how hard I pinch, I never wake up. I'd better keep trying.
column2: 无论我掐得多狠，都醒不过来。我最好继续试。

column1: If I go, who will catch you when you slip?
column2: 我要是走了，你滑下去时谁来接住你？

column1: A dream. Maybe it's a dream?
column2: 一场梦。也许是梦？

column1: Yes, that's much better isn't it?
column2: 对，这样好多了，不是吗？

column1: I tried, I tried.
column2: 我试了，我试了。

column1: Is all this blood... mine?
column2: 这些血……是我的吗？

column1: No no no no, it's my own! You can't have it!
column2: 不，不，不，不，这是我自己的！你不能拿走！

column1: Take it and see! Haha, oh, you'll see!
column2: 拿去看！哈哈，哦，你会明白的

column1: Not this close! No, cut the thread, cut the thread!
column2: 别靠这么近！不，剪断线，剪断线！

column1: One end 'round your wrist, yes, wind it nice and tight. Don't let go, don't you dare.
column2: 一头绕上你的手腕，对，绕得又好又紧。别松手，你敢松开。

column1: Wind the spool a little longer, then. Yes, longer.
column2: 那就把线轴再绕长一些。对，再长一些。

column1: Oh, now you've done it. What if you slip? I won't let you fall, no.
column2: 哦，你这下答应了。要是你滑倒呢？我不会让你掉下去，不会。

column1: You aren't allowed to leave now. Stay and talk. Use my ears and I will use your lips.
column2: 你现在不许走。留下来说话。用我的耳朵，我来用你的嘴唇。

column1: Pretty voices. Stay and sing for me.
column2: 漂亮的声音。留下来为我唱歌。

column1: Don't step down the path, lest the stones come loose and you can't return.
column2: 别沿那条路走下去，免得石头松了，你就回不来。

column1: No, safer that way. Much safer.
column2: 不，那样更安全。安全得多。

column1: The fire is so pretty. Hard to look away, but sometimes something else shines too, something glittering at the edge of seeing. Mostly I can't catch them, but this time, oh this time I caught one. It's for you. It will make you happy.
column2: 火真漂亮。很难把目光移开，可有时候别的东西也会发光，那种在视线边缘闪烁的东西。大多时候我抓不住它们，可这一次，哦这一次我抓住了一个。给你。它会让你高兴。

column1: Maybe I can find some string? I can wind a pretty lace to make everyone happy. You'd like that, yes?
column2: 也许我能找到些细绳？我可以绕出一条漂亮的花边，让大家都高兴。你会喜欢的，对吧？

column1: Oh, no it's not supposed to be like that, no.
column2: 哦，不，不该是那样的，不。

column1: It's quiet.
column2: 好安静。

column1: It's much better. Here, I'll make something pretty for you, you'll see.
column2: 这样好多了。来，我给你做个漂亮的，你会看见的。

column1: I can feel it fraying. It won't be long now, no, not long.
column2: 我能感觉到它在散丝。不会久了，不，不会久。

column1: No fuckin' problem.
column2: 他妈没问题。

column1: We got this one.
column2: 这个我们搞得定。

column1: Whaddaya think?\nShould we mess with that?
column2: 你觉得呢？\n要不要去折腾那个？

column1: What the fuck is that?
column2: 那他妈是什么？

column1: Aw shit, why'd it have to be you?
column2: 啊，操，怎么偏偏是你？

column1: Hey, don't you dare leave me now!
column2: 嘿，你现在可别丢下我！

column1: Well, ain't this place charming?
column2: 哟，这地方可真迷人？

column1: I'm shakin' like a leaf here.
column2: 我在这儿抖得跟叶子似的。

column1: That's it, we're fucked.
column2: 完了，我们被操了。

column1: In case we don't make it,\nI love you.
column2: 万一我们过不去，\n我爱你。

column1: None of that.\nI'm here, ain't I?
column2: 别说那些。\n我不是在这儿吗？

column1: Well it just gives me the chance to\nshow off for you, don't it?
column2: 这不正好给我机会\n在你面前露一手吗？

column1: Shut your trap, I ain't goin' down that easy.
column2: 闭上你的嘴，我才不会这么轻易倒下。

column1: Blah blah blah, shut up and fight.
column2: 叭叭叭，闭嘴开打。

column1: Yeah, good riddance, asshole.
column2: 对，死了正好，混蛋。

column1: Anybody else want a drink?\nI want a drink.
column2: 还有谁想喝一杯？\n我想喝一杯。

column1: This is great, I ain't been around this many people since forever! 'Course I could do with a few more of 'em getting a bit closer, but at this point I'll take what company I can get.  Anyway, was there something you needed, or you just come by to fraternize? I'm good either way.
column2: 这可真好，我好久没跟这么多人待一块儿了！当然，要是再有几个贴得更近点就更好，不过到了这地步，能有人陪我就认了。总之，你是有事找我，还是过来套近乎的？哪种我都好。

column1: Aww, come on, really? I didn't do anything to deserve the boot, did I?
column2: 哎呀，别这样，真的吗？我又没干什么该被踹走的事，对吧？

column1: Well ain't you a sight for sore eyes?
column2: 哟，看见你可真养眼？

column1: Naw, I didn't think so. I'm just friendlier than most, you'll get used to it!
column2: 才不，我就知道你不是那个意思。我就是比大多数人更爱亲近人，你会习惯的！

column1: Just when things were starting to get good, too. Well, bye.
column2: 偏偏事情刚开始有意思。好吧，再见。

column1: Ah, fuck me, you're strong.
column2: 啊，我操，你可真强。

column1: Hey, fuck you, I need that!
column2: 嘿，去你妈的，我还要用那个！

column1: It ain't worth dyin' over. Take it and let me go!
column2: 这不值得送命。拿走，放我走！

column1: I don't work for nobody but me. You can take those terms and cram 'em up your arse!
column2: 我才不给任何人干活，只给自己干。那些条件，你塞进你屁眼里去吧！

column1: Well shit, I'm in no position to argue. My ass is yours I guess.
column2: 好吧，操，我也没资格争。我的屁股归你了，大概。

column1: Don't gotta tell me twice.
column2: 不用跟我说第二遍。

column1: Music to my ears! How's about a hug to seal the deal? No? Later then.
column2: 真是动听！拥抱一下成交怎么样？不要？那以后再说。

column1: Hey now, no need to be shy, I'm not in a biting mood just at the moment. You're lookin' pretty healthy, you ain't been here that long I guess? You know it sure does get lonely out here, struggling to survive all by yourself.
column2: 嘿，别害羞，我这会儿可没咬人的兴致。你看上去挺健康的，大概来这儿还没多久吧？你知道，一个人在外头拼命活命，可真够孤单的。

column1: Hi, stranger. How's it going?
column2: 嗨，陌生人。怎么样？

column1: I thought you'd never ask! You make sure I don't get lonely and I'll do whatever you want. What do you say?
column2: 我还以为你永远不会开口！你保证别让我孤单，你要我干什么我都干。你说呢？

column1: Ah well, it's a nice thought, but I'd rather be lonely and alone than lonely in a crowd. You take care now.
column2: 啊，这想法不错，可我宁可一个人孤单，也不想挤在人群里孤单。你多保重。

column1: Hey. You know, the firelight has a way of highlighting all your best features. When we first met I never figured on how strong and reliable you'd be. I guess it just goes to show that sometimes you can't know all there is about someone just by lookin' at 'em, right? Well, you must know a thing or two about that, seein' as you keep me around even when I act the way I do. Take this, will you? Just a little something to remember me by, just in case.
column2: 嘿。你知道，火光总会把你身上最好看的地方照出来。我们初次见面时，我从没想到你会这么强、这么靠得住。看来有时候光看着一个人，是没法知道全部的，对吧？嗯，你对此肯定也懂一些，毕竟我这样行事，你还是把我留在身边。收下这个，好吗？一点小东西，用来记得我，以防万一。

column1: Ain't it weirdly satisfying to be living like this? Away from all the rules and the expectations, just a bunch of jolly rejects clinging together for warmth in the dark of night. Did you like that? I'm a fuckin' poet.
column2: 这样过日子不是怪让人满足的吗？远离所有规矩和期待，就一帮快活的弃儿，在黑夜里挤在一起取暖。喜欢这段吗？我他妈就是个诗人。

column1: Aww, don't say that to me now! Not when I'm this attached. Am I really that bad?
column2: 哎呀，现在别对我说这种话！我都这么黏上你了。我真有那么糟吗？

column1: I was just thinking about you! How you doing?
column2: 我正想着你呢！你怎么样？

column1: Don't mess with me like that! I got feelings too, you know.
column2: 别这么耍我！我也是有感情的，知道吗。

column1: Well fuck. I kinda wish you'd just stabbed me. Now I gotta be alone and brokenhearted to boot. It's not fuckin' fair.
column2: 好吧，操。我倒希望你直接捅了我。现在我既得一个人，还得心碎。这他妈不公平。

column1: The fighting just never stops.
column2: 这架是永远打不完了。

column1: Come on then. I'll kill you all if I have to.
column2: 那就来吧。必要的话，我会把你们全杀了。

column1: Oh good. Another thing to deal with.
column2: 哦，好啊。又一件要对付的事。

column1: Who knows what might happen?\nWe'd best not.
column2: 谁知道会出什么事？\n我们最好别碰。

column1: No!  It's all falling apart!
column2: 不！一切都在崩塌！

column1: Oh God, no!
column2: 哦，上帝，不！

column1: This place is singularly unpleasant.
column2: 这地方格外令人难受。

column1: Are you quite certain we need to be here?
column2: 你十分确定我们有必要待在这儿吗？

column1: This is it, then isn't it?
column2: 那么，就到此为止了，是不是？

column1: We're all going to die.\nI knew this would happen!
column2: 我们都要死了。\n我就知道会这样！

column1: I feel like that all the time, but it's not real!\nFight!
column2: 我一直都有这种感觉，可那不是真的！\n打啊！

column1: You don't really believe that!
column2: 你不是真这么相信的！

column1: We're not that weak! We're not!
column2: 我们没那么弱！才没有！

column1: Don't say that, you're scaring me!
column2: 别这么说，你吓着我了！

column1: That... that's okay, right?
column2: 那……那样没关系，对吧？

column1: Better you than... anyone, really.
column2: 死的是你，总比……任何人好，真的。

column1: So are we going to keep bringing in more people? I shudder to think of what some of them did to get here. What a wretched place to end up, being forced to rely on a lot such as this. \nSorry, did you need something?
column2: 所以我们还要继续往里带人吗？一想到他们有些人是干了什么才落到这儿的，我就发抖。落到这种地方，还不得不依靠这样一帮人，真是悲惨。\n抱歉，你需要什么吗？

column1: Ah. I must admit, I've thought of leaving myself. Do you want me to go?
column2: 啊。我得承认，我自己也想过离开。你要我走吗？

column1: Well, we aren't dead yet. That's something.
column2: 嗯，我们还没死。这好歹算一件事。

column1: I suppose I'll stay on for the time being then.
column2: 那我眼下就暂时留下吧。

column1: My things are already packed. You don't mind if I fill up my waterskin first, right?
column2: 东西我已经收拾好了。你不介意我先把水袋灌满吧？

column1: I can't take this anymore.
column2: 我受不了了。

column1: That's what my life is worth? Just finish me off.
column2: 我这条命就值这个？干脆了结了我吧。

column1: Alright, take it. If I die, it will be worthless anyway.
column2: 好吧，拿走。我要是死了，它反正也一文不值。

column1: I'd rather die than toil under your thumb. Just end this!
column2: 我宁可死，也不愿在你手下卖命。结束吧！

column1: Work for you? Do I even have a choice, really?
column2: 给你干活？我真还有得选吗？

column1: Do you think you're being kind? There's no kindness here. Remember that.
column2: 你以为这是仁慈？这儿没有仁慈。记住这一点。

column1: Well, lead the way then. We'll see how this goes.
column2: 那你带路吧。看看会怎样。

column1: I don't want any of this. I had a home and a life, and now it's all gone. Now I'm reduced to hiding in cellars and scrounging for food unfit for swine. Maybe I'd be better off to have stayed in the stocks.
column2: 我什么都不想要。我曾经有家，有日子过，现在全没了。如今我沦落到躲在地窖里，翻找连猪都不肯吃的食物。也许当初留在枷场还更好。

column1: Just stay away from me, please.
column2: 请离我远一点。

column1: Go with you? I don't think that's a good idea. Then again, I don't think being alone in this place is a good idea either. I suppose I'll come along, just for a while.
column2: 跟你走？我觉得不是好主意。可话说回来，一个人待在这地方也不是好主意。我想我就跟你走一阵吧。

column1: Yes, well as I said, it's probably not a good idea. I don't know you.
column2: 是啊，正如我说的，这大概不是好主意。我不认识你。

column1: Since we've met, I think you've put on some weight. That is, you're doing well, thriving even. You've put together a group of the most rotten people I can imagine and managed to make something liveable out of it. I don't know how much help I've been along the way, but I know that I'm better off in your company than out of it, and... I wanted to thank you for having me. Please, take this.
column2: 自从我们相识，我觉得你长了些肉。我是说，你过得不错，甚至算兴旺。你把我能想象到的最烂的人拢成了一支团伙，还设法把日子过得能住人。我不知道这一路我帮上了多少，可我知道跟着你比不跟着你好，而且……我想谢谢你肯留着我。请收下这个。

column1: I began talking with some of the others recently. Some are unapologetic scum of course, but some of them claim to be innocent, and some are guilty of things I didn't even realize were crimes. Some should have received a paltry fine instead of exile. I'm not sure what's going on, but there's something that smells quite wrong about all of this.
column2: 最近我开始跟另外一些人说话。有些人当然是毫不悔改的人渣，可有些人自称无辜，还有些人犯的事，我甚至没意识到那也算罪。有些人本该只罚一笔微不足道的罚金，而不是流放。我不知道这是怎么回事，可这一切都透着股很不对的味道。

column1: You want me to leave? After everything we've been through? Are you quite sure?
column2: 你要我离开？在我们经历了这一切之后？你十分确定？

column1: Things are quiet for the moment.
column2: 眼下还算安静。

column1: Testing my committment then? Don't worry, I'm not going to go anywhere.
column2: 那是在试我的忠诚？别担心，我哪儿也不去。

column1: Well, I knew it was only a matter of time, I suppose.
column2: 嗯，我想我也知道，这只是迟早的事。

column1: Deep breath.\nWe've been through worse.
column2: 深吸一口气。\n我们经历过更糟的。

column1: Okay, focus.
column2: 好，集中精神。

column1: Do you think we should touch that?
column2: 你觉得我们该碰那个吗？

column1: I'm not sure this is safe.
column2: 我不确定这安不安全。

column1: Oh God, I'm next, aren't I?
column2: 哦，上帝，下一个是我了，对吧？

column1: No no no no!
column2: 不，不，不，不！

column1: I... I thought I heard something just now.
column2: 我……我刚才好像听见什么了。

column1: What was that noise?
column2: 那是什么声音？

column1: Oh God, no, please don't hurt me!
column2: 哦，上帝，不，求你别伤害我！

column1: I'm gonna die, I'm gonna die!
column2: 我要死了，我要死了！

column1: No we... we'll laugh about it later.\nYou'll see.
column2: 不，我们……我们以后会笑着说起这事的。\n你看着吧。

column1: If it starts to go bad, we're going to run, right?
column2: 要是情况开始变糟，我们就跑，对吧？

column1: Stop it!\nI can barely stand as it is!
column2: 别这样！\n我现在都快站不住了！

column1: I'm... sure we have a plan, right?\nAnybody?
column2: 我……肯定我们有计划的，对吧？\n有人吗？

column1: They're too strong!\nWe have to run!
column2: 他们太强了！\n我们得跑！

column1: This can't be happening!
column2: 这不可能发生！

column1: Just throw us on a boat and dump us here? How can they even be allowed to do this to us? Does anybody at home even know what they're doing, what kind of place this is? Can't I just wake up and have this all be just a bad dream?
column2: 就把我们扔上一条船，丢在这儿？他们怎么能被允许这样对我们？家里还有人知道他们在干什么吗，知道这是个什么地方吗？我就不能醒过来，发现这一切只是一场噩梦吗？

column1: You want me to leave? Okay, just please don't hurt me!
column2: 你要我走？好，只求你别伤害我！

column1: I can't believe what a mess this is.
column2: 我真不敢相信，这乱成什么样了。

column1: I... I don't know how much more of this I can take.
column2: 我……我不知道自己还能再受多少。

column1: I'm going.
column2: 我走了。

column1: Stop! Please, don't hurt me!
column2: 停下！求你，别伤害我！

column1: I don't have anything to give you!  You're going to kill me aren't you? Oh god, get away from me!
column2: 我没什么能给你的！你是要杀了我，对不对？哦，上帝，离我远点！

column1: Yes of course, just don't hurt me!
column2: 好，当然，只要别伤害我就行！

column1: No, please, anything but that!
column2: 不，求你，怎样都好，就是别那样！

column1: Fine, anything you want!
column2: 好吧，你要什么都行！

column1: Oh thank you! I'll go right away!
column2: 哦，谢谢你！我马上就走！

column1: Sure, alright. Just... lead the way and I'll be right behind you.
column2: 好，行。就……你带路，我紧跟在后面。

column1: I haven't spoken to anybody since I got here. Everyone just wants to rob me or rape me or worse. Please... you're making me really nervous. Can't you just leave me be?
column2: 我到这儿之后还没跟任何人说过话。每个人都只想抢我、强奸我，或者干更糟的事。求你……你让我紧张得不行。你就不能让我一个人待着吗？

column1: Get back! I don't want any trouble!
column2: 退后！我不想惹麻烦！

column1: You... want me to go with you? You'll keep me safe?
column2: 你……要我跟你走？你会保护我的吧？

column1: Please leave me alone! Please!
column2: 求你让我一个人待着！求你！

column1: You know, I don't understand why I'm still here. I'm not strong, I'm not useful, but you keep me around anyway. You must have an awfully big heart to spare so much pity for a miserable thing like me. I would never have survived this long without you, so I just wanted to say thank you. You give me hope that maybe I'll somehow make it through all this. Here. It's not much of a gift, but it's the only thing I have of any value. Take it, please.

column2: 什么？可你需要我，不是吗？我是说，我还以为我们……你是认真要我就这么走？

column1: Hey, I'm bored. Wanna wrestle? No? Maybe later.
column2: 嘿，我无聊了。想摔跤吗？不想？那以后再说。

column1: Well don't scare me like that! I don't want to leave.
column2: 别那样吓我！我不想走。

column1: I really respect you, and that is the only thing that is keeping me from punching your lights out right now.  Get out of my way.
column2: 我是真敬重你，也就只有这个，才让我现在没一拳打得你两眼发黑。别挡道。

column1: This arrangement seems good so far.
column2: 到目前为止，这样安排似乎不错。

column1: You want me to leave?
column2: 你要我离开？

column1: Hello ally.
column2: 你好，盟友。

column1: Then I shall remain for now.
column2: 那我暂时留下。

column1: Fine, I will go. Goodbye.
column2: 好吧，我走。再见。

column1: You have beaten me. What is your intention?
column2: 你打败了我。你有何打算？

column1: I don't think so. You'll have to wrest it from my corpse.
column2: 我不这么想。你得从我的尸体上把它夺过去。

column1: Fine. I trade this for my life.
column2: 好。我用这个换我的命。

column1: I'd sooner die than serve you.
column2: 我宁死也不为你效力。

column1: Very well, I will join you.
column2: 很好，我加入你。

column1: I will leave then.
column2: 那我这就离开。

column1: Do you want something?
column2: 你想要什么？

column1: Hello stranger.
column2: 你好，陌生人。

column1: Yes, I will join you, if you accept my terms.
column2: 是的，如果你接受我的条件，我就加入你。

column1: If you cannot accept my terms, I cannot join you.
column2: 如果你不能接受我的条件，我就不能加入你。

column1: You have honoured our deal, and I thank you. This is a gift for you.
column2: 你信守了我们的约定，我感谢你。这是给你的礼物。

column1: I am pleased to be here.
column2: 我很高兴能在这里。

column1: Hello friend.
column2: 你好，朋友。

column1: Carry the food, carry the loot, I don't care. Load me up and let's go.
column2: 搬食物也好，搬战利品也好，我不在乎。给我装满，咱们走。

column1: Did you need me for something?
column2: 你找我有事吗？

column1: Right behind you.
column2: 我就在你身后。

column1: What a charming... place... you've put together here, and I would know. You can tell by just looking at me that I have impeccable taste, not to mention my credentials. That's why merchants are in such a good mood while I'm around, of course.
column2: 你在这儿收拾出来的这地方……可真迷人……我可看得出来。你一看我就知道，我品味无可挑剔，更别提我的资历。所以有我在，商人们心情当然都特别好。

column1: Oh hello!
column2: 哦，你好！

column1: Naturally. You keep the gears turning, and I'll keep everything well-oiled.
column2: 那是自然。你负责让齿轮转下去，我负责把一切上足油。

column1: You know, it's a good thing I am here, or every passing merchant would swindle you for your last quarter! You can trust me, of course. More gold for you means more gold for the stronghold, and what's good for the stronghold is good for all of us!
column2: 你知道，幸好有我在，不然每个路过的商人都会把你骗到最后一个铜板都不剩！你当然可以信任我。你的金子多了，据点的金子也就多了，对据点有好处，就是对我们大家都有好处！

column1: Greetings to you!
column2: 向你问好！

column1: I'll stay on top of those slippery vendors, don't you worry!
column2: 那些滑头商贩我会盯紧的，你放心！

column1: No doubt you come to see me because you've heard tales of my wondrous brew! You want someone turned into a toad, or wounds magically healed? I can do these things, and much more!
column2: 你来找我，准是听说了我那神妙药酿的传闻！想把谁变成蟾蜍，还是想让伤口神奇地愈合？这些我都能做，还能做的多着呢！

column1: Well hello there, Deary. Come to visit your Nan, have you?
column2: 哟，你好啊，乖乖。来看你奶奶了，是不是？

column1: I won't be staying on long, Deary, so buy what you need while you can!
column2: 我不会久留的，乖乖，想买什么就趁现在！

column1: You know, I hear all kinds of interesting things here. People trust the man who pours the drinks, so I make sure everyone gets their fair share. If you want to leave any stuff for me to keep tucked away, or to sell off for coin, just put it there and I'll take care of it.
column2: 你知道，我在这儿能听到各种有意思的事。人们都信任给自己倒酒的人，所以我保证每个人都得到该得的那份。你要是想把东西留给我收着，或者卖掉换钱，放那儿就行，我来料理。

column1: Sit down for a spell.
column2: 坐下来歇一会儿。

column1: Don't go gettin' yourself killed, now.
column2: 可别把自己弄死了啊。

column1: I am right behind you.
column2: 我就紧跟在你身后。

column1: I ain't scared! I ain't!
column2: 我才不怕！才不怕！

column1: Let me take a look.
column2: 让我看看。

column1: Want me to take care of that?
column2: 要我来搞定吗？

column1: We got a man down!
column2: 有人倒了！

column1: Don't just stand there!
column2: 别光站着！

column1: Feels good to be walkin' around.
column2: 能四处走走，感觉真好。

column1: Hear that? Guess I'm just jumpy.
column2: 什么声音？大概是我太紧张了。

column1: It's the fish all over again!
column2: 又是那些鱼人！

column1: I'm ready to die.
column2: 我准备好死了。

column1: We'll come through, you'll see!
column2: 我们能挺过去的，你看着吧！

column1: The boss will take 'em!
column2: 老大会收拾他们的！

column1: Quit your blubberin' and fight!
column2: 别哭哭啼啼的，给我打！

column1: Don't be so damn stupid.
column2: 别他妈这么蠢。

column1: Step it up, or that's all of us!
column2: 加把劲，不然我们全完了！

column1: That looked like it hurt.
column2: 看着就疼。

column1: Ugh, I still can't get the fish smell out of my beard. Still, there'd be worse in it if you hadn't come along when you did. I don't care what you did to end up here, you saved me and that's worth something, so I'm with you. Whatever you need.
column2: 呃，我胡子上的鱼腥味还是去不掉。不过，要不是你那时候来了，胡子里的东西只会更糟。我不在乎你是因为什么才落到这儿的，你救了我，这就值了，所以我跟你。你需要什么都行。

column1: Are you sure? I mean, are you going to be able to hold this place together without me?
column2: 你确定？我是说，没了我，你还撑得住这地方吗？

column1: Hey, good to see you! Everything going well today, I hope?
column2: 嘿，见到你真好！希望你今天一切都顺？

column1: I won't hear it. I still owe you for saving my life, and I'll find some way to be of use, you'll see.
column2: 这话我可不听。你救过我的命，我还欠着，我会找到办法派上用场的，你看着吧。

column1: It's a shame I didn't get a chance to pay you back proper for what you did, but I won't argue. Try not to get yourself killed, alright?
column2: 可惜我还没机会好好报答你，不过我不争。尽量别把自己弄死，好吗？

column1: What the fuck are you trying to do? Are you crazy?
column2: 你他妈到底想干什么？你疯了吗？

column1: In case you didn't notice, I don't have shit all! If you're going to kill me just get it over with!
column2: 你没看见吗，我他妈屁都没有！要杀我就痛快点！

column1: Take it, I'm gone!
column2: 拿走，我走了！

column1: After seing how you treat people, I don't think so! Fuck you!
column2: 看你怎么待人，我想都别想！去你妈的！

column1: You could've just said so, you fucking psycho!
column2: 你早说不就得了，你这他妈的疯子！

column1: Why didn't you goddamn say so? Fuck.
column2: 你他妈怎么不早说？操。

column1: Well, this day is lookin' up! I'll be right behind you. Need me to carry a torch or anything?
column2: 嘿，今天有盼头了！我就跟在你后面。要我拿火把什么的吗？

column1: Me and a few others ended up stuck in the cliffs when the boat they pushed us in on went off course. Sahaguin rounded us up and put us in this cell. The others were all dragged off. Drowned and diced up for fish food no doubt. There's a lot of ways to die, and almost any of 'em are better than that.
column2: 他们把我们推进一条船，船偏离了航线，我和另外几个人就困在了悬崖里。沙华鱼人把我们抓起来，关进了这间牢房。其他人全被拖走了。肯定是淹死，再剁碎了当鱼食。死法多的是，几乎哪一种都比这个强。

column1: Thanks so much. I ain't got much to offer, but I'd at least like to shake your hand.
column2: 太感谢了。我没什么能给的，但至少想跟你握个手。

column1: Really? I mean, I'm in your debt for sure, and it ain't like I got anywhere else to be. I ain't much of a fighter, but I'll help out however I can.
column2: 真的？我是说，我肯定欠你的，而且我也没别处可去。我不怎么能打，能帮的我都帮。

column1: You saved my life, and I well know it. I'll bugger off once I catch my breath and scavenge what I can from this camp.
column2: 你救了我的命，我清楚得很。我喘过这口气，把这营地里能搜的搜一搜，就滚蛋。

column1:
A stupid deer. That was what got me sent here, you know? 

I hunted in the forest back home for years. I mean, sure I knew it was poaching, but I never figured it mattered. 

Not like the duke could eat every deer, right? 

I did it for so long I hardly even thought about it. 

|Well one day I'm out with my bow and I bag this monster stag. You should've seen the rack on it! 

Turns out though, I wasn't the only one out for a hunt. Me up to my elbows in deer guts and who comes riding along but old twirly-tits himself, and a half dozen sidekicks besides. 

He nearly shot me dead right there, but one of his hounds convinced him it would be more fitting to have me shipped out here. 

I didn't think he could really make it happen, but here I am. 

|So ends the story of Bato. 

At least, that's how I thought it ended, before you came along and hauled my ass out of the brine. 

Because of you, I get a chance to write a better ending, and I will never, ever forget. 

I am your man, and glad about it.
column2:
一头蠢鹿。我就是因为这个被送到这儿的，你知道吗？ 

我在家乡的森林里打了好多年猎。我是说，我当然知道那是偷猎，可我从没觉得这有什么要紧。 

公爵又吃不完每一头鹿，对吧？ 

我干了这么久，几乎都不再去想它了。 

|有一天我带着弓出门，射倒了一头大得吓人的公鹿。你真该看看那对鹿角！ 

结果出来打猎的不止我一个。我两条胳膊肘都埋在鹿内脏里，这时骑过来的不是别人，正是奶子打转的那位老东西本人，旁边还跟着五六个跟班。 

他差点当场就把我射死，可他手下一条走狗劝他，把我用船送到这儿更合适。 

我没想到他真能办成，可我人就在这儿。 

|到此为止，这就是 Bato 的故事。 

至少，在你出现、把我的屁股从咸水里拽出来之前，我以为故事就是这么结束的。 

因为你，我才有机会写出一个更好的结局，而我永远、永远不会忘记。 

我是你的人，而且心甘情愿。

column1: Seems like forever ago we were crawling through that damned cave together. I never thought of myself as much of an adventurer you know, but this? After staring fishy death in the face, I am having more fun than I ever did. We got something good here, and it's thanks to you.
column2: 我们一起爬过那个该死的洞窟，好像已经是很久以前了。你知道，我从没觉得自己算什么冒险者，可现在呢？跟那张鱼脸的死神对视过之后，我过得比哪天都快活。我们在这儿有了点好东西，这都得谢你。

column1: Wait, what? After all my hard work I get the boot?
column2: 等等，什么？我这么卖力，就换来一脚踢开？

column1: Everything's in order here. Got something on your mind?
column2: 这儿一切都妥当。你心里有事？

column1: I know I ain't as tough as some of these fuckers, but I do more to keep this place in order than you might think. Please trust me.
column2: 我知道我没这帮狗东西能打，可我为了让这地方保持秩序做的，比你想的多。请你相信我。

column1: Alright, fine. You're the boss, and I don't owe you nothin' anymore.
column2: 行，好吧。你是老大，我也不再欠你什么了。

column1: I haven't forgotten how to fight!
column2: 我还没忘记如何战斗！

column1: Some things never change.
column2: 有些事从不改变。

column1: Is this important?
column2: 这要紧吗？

column1: Something's there.
column2: 那儿有东西。

column1: We're losing numbers!
column2: 我们在减员！

column1: Man down!
column2: 有人倒下！

column1: Ort.
column2: Ort。

column1: I could do with a sit down.
column2: 我真想坐下歇一歇。

column1: Come then. \nI am already dead.
column2: 来吧。 \n我早已死了。

column1: I'll drag you down with me!
column2: 我要拖着你一起下去！

column1: Keep a cool head,\nand we will win!
column2: 保持冷静，\n我们必胜！

column1: Get into position!
column2: 就位！

column1: Quiet, soldier!\nForm up!
column2: 安静，士兵！\n列队！

column1: Either form up, \nor fall back!
column2: 要么列队， \n要么后撤！

column1: This isn't going well.
column2: 情况不妙。

column1: Press the advantage!
column2: 乘胜追击！

column1: I am well-used to living like this, moving from holdout to holdout, fighting skirmishes, rationing supplies. If not for the utter ruin of this place, I could believe that nothing has changed.
column2: 我早已习惯如此度日，在一个个据守点之间转移，打遭遇战，配给补给。若不是此地已彻底化为废墟，我几乎会相信，什么都没有改变。

column1: Is that the end already? I had hoped to be of some use.
column2: 这就结束了吗？我本希望还能派上些用场。

column1: Ort! How goes the campaign?
column2: Ort！战事如何？

column1: I shall redouble my efforts. If there is anything I can do for you, please do not leave it unsaid.
column2: 我会加倍努力。若有我能为你做的，请尽管说，不要藏着不说。

column1: Then I shall go and see for myself what has become of my ruined homeland. Farewell.
column2: 那我便亲自去看看，我那已成废墟的故土如今如何。再会。

column1: Ora noct! You win.
column2: Ora noct！你赢了。

column1: It's all I have left!
column2: 这是我仅剩的一切了！

column1: Orid katch.
column2: Orid katch。

column1: Think you that I am a dog, to come at your command?
column2: 你当我是一条狗，唤一声就来吗？

column1: You had only to ask in the first place! Pray that misunderstandings like this be not common between us.
column2: 你起初开口问一声便是！但愿这样的误会，不要成为我们之间的常事。

column1: Hmph. Fine.
column2: 哼。好吧。

column1: Very well. I shall follow where you lead.
column2: 那好。你领向何处，我便跟向何处。

column1: I am a... remnant, a relic. My time was long ago, and yet here I stand. How long has it been? A hundred years? A thousand? Men such as I were not meant to step so through time.
column2: 我是……残留之人，一件遗物。我的时代早已过去，可我还站在这里。过了多久了？一百年？一千年？像我这样的人，本不该这样一步迈过时间。

column1: What am I to do now?
column2: 我如今该做什么？

column1: You would have me? I may know nothing of the current state of the world, but my arm is still strong.
column2: 你愿意要我？这世道如今如何，我一无所知，可我的手臂仍旧有力。

column1: I am a captain of a long-dead army. What place is there for me in this world?
column2: 我是一支覆灭已久的军队的队长。这世上还有我的位置吗？

column1:
If I may have a word?

It is strange for me to work in such an unstructured group. 

Everyone manages to hold it together and look out for one another, but my rank means little. 

Don't think I'm complaining, of course! 

It's difficult to describe exactly how I feel, but my whole world has been turned upside down, so it almost feels proper, like just one more thing to have been left behind.

|I've been thinking about what I would have done, if I had been released from that curse before you arrived, if I woke up in that place alone. 

I am no stranger to confusion now, of course, but I can only imagine how much worse it would have been. I might very well have fallen upon my own blade in desperation. I still think about doing it sometimes, but then seeing everything you've built stops me. 

You've given an old relic some direction, and a glimpse of clarity in a world that isn't meant for me. 

For that, I thank you. 

|This is something the Queen gave to me long ago. 

It isn't really worth anything, and it isn't even gold. No more than a trinket, I suppose, but it was a symbol of my duty to her. 

Now that that duty has been fulfilled, I have no need of it, and I offer it to you instead, as a token of my loyalty. 

Where you lead, Beauregard will follow. This, I promise.
column2:
我能说句话吗？

在这样一支毫无编制的队伍里做事，对我来说很陌生。

大家倒也能撑住，并且彼此照应，可我的军衔几乎没有分量。

当然，别以为我是在抱怨！

我很难把感受说得确切，可我的整个世界都颠倒了，所以这几乎显得正当，就像又一件该被留在身后的事。

|我一直在想，倘若在你到来之前那诅咒就已解除，倘若我独自在那地方醒来，我会做出什么。

我如今对迷茫已不陌生，可我能想象，那会糟糕得多。我很可能就会在绝望中伏剑自尽。有时我仍会想起这件事，可一看见你建起的这一切，便停住了。

你给了一件老遗物一个方向，也让我在这个本就不是为我准备的世界里，瞥见了一线清明。

为此，我感谢你。

|这是女王很久以前给我的东西。

它其实值不了什么，甚至不是金子。我想，不过一件小玩意儿，可它曾是我对她尽职的象征。

如今那份职责已经尽完，我不再需要它，便把它献给你，作为我忠诚的信物。

你领向何处，Beauregard 就跟向何处。这一点，我承诺。

column1: Some of the others have taken to calling me "Captain". At first, I thought they were mocking me, but I have begun to feel comforted by it. It is familiar, and familiarity is a rare treat for me. In any case, was there something you needed, or did you just come to hear me complain?
column2: 另外有些人渐渐管我叫“队长”。起初我以为他们在嘲弄我，可我开始从中得到安慰。这称呼熟悉，而熟悉对我是难得的享受。总之，你是有事找我，还是专程来听我抱怨？

column1: You have no further need of me? I am saddened to hear it.
column2: 你不再需要我了？听到这话，我很难过。

column1: Ort, friend! How can I serve you?
column2: Ort，朋友！要我为你做什么？

column1: It is cruel of you to toy with me like this. Either you need me or you do not. Best decide for certain.
column2: 你这样戏弄我，未免残忍。要么需要我，要么不需要。最好拿定主意。

column1: I am not sure what to do, but... I won't argue with you. Just let me gather some supplies and I'll be gone.
column2: 我不知道该做什么，可是……我不跟你争。让我收拾些补给，随即就走。

column1: If you want me to improve your weapons, bring me two pieces. I'll combine the best bits of both to make something even better. Identical pieces usually work best, but sometimes I can make different ones work. Try it and see, I guess!
column2: 你要是想让我把武器改好，就拿两件来。我会把两件里最好的部分拼到一起，做出更好的。一模一样的通常最好用，不过有时候不同的我也能凑合。试试就知道了，我想！

column1: Something I can do for you?
column2: 有什么要我做的？

column1: Back to work then. Take care.
column2: 那我回去干活了。保重。

column1: Gimme a break.
column2: 得了吧。

column1: Come on, really?
column2: 不是吧，认真的？

column1: Over there.
column2: 在那边。

column1: What's that?
column2: 那是什么？

column1: Well, shit.
column2: 哎，操。

column1: That's not good.
column2: 这可不妙。

column1: Did you hear that?
column2: 你听见了吗？

column1: Nothing, sorry.
column2: 没什么，抱歉。

column1: Ah shit. Here it comes, everyone.
column2: 啊，操。来了，大伙儿。

column1: Been nice knowin' ya.
column2: 能认识你们，挺好的。

column1: Just put your back into it.
column2: 使上劲就行了。

column1: Are we lookin' at the same guys? We can do this.
column2: 咱们看的是同一拨人吗？咱们打得过。

column1: Shut up, you're throwing me off!
column2: 闭嘴，你让我分心了！

column1: If that's how you feel, why don't you just run?
column2: 你要是这么想，干嘛不干脆跑？

column1:
Hey boss. Sorry to bug you."

Borfalgor sits down in front of the fire, and thumbs the amulet around his neck idly.

"I was talking to some of the others. 

Everyone has their secrets, right? Them marks you all got on your necks, I mean. 

I can't read 'em, but I heard someone say they mean something. Labels for things you did, or things someone says you did, right?

Goblins, they don't do anything so complicated. If someone does something bad, they bash his skull in with a rock and be done with it.

|I say "they" instead of "we", you might've noticed. 

I don't have a lot in common with goblins anymore, and I haven't for a long time. I did once, to be sure, but then this amulet here changed everything.

You remember how when you found me, I couldn't remember why I was at that temple? Well, it was like that when I first ended up with this thing too. 

The amulet makes me smart, see, and when I'm smart, stupid thoughts don't make sense anymore. It's like trying to read scratches when you aren't even sure if they're words at all. 

|What I'm saying is that I don't remember how I got this thing.

Goblins can work some basic magic, sure, but nothing as complicated as a magic amulet, and even if they could, I ain't a mage and goblins don't share. It's probably more likely that someone gave it to me, or that I found it, or stole it. 

Probably that last one. 

I'm just spinning a tale with this of course, but I imagine that I probably brained some poor old hermit and took his shiny necklace.

|Whatever happened, putting this thing on made it impossible for me to live with goblins anymore. 

I could barely speak to them, much less relate to them. 

Since then, there's been no place for me to fit, no place to feel that I belong.

I'm not saying that I belong here necessarily, but I think at least everybody else here also feels like they don't belong, and that's something, ain't it?

|So there it is, anyway. My big secret, or as close to one as I got. 

Maybe I still owe you for the rescue back then, or maybe I don't. I'll leave that up to you, but I'm along for me now, not for you. Let's see where this goes, hmm?"

Borfalgor stands up, his stature surprisingly dignified for such a small creature, and he turns toward you.

"I put something in your chest. Just a little thing I found. I was going to keep it for myself, but... I would rather you have it. As my way of saying thanks.
column2:
嘿，头目。抱歉来烦你。”

Borfalgor 在火前坐下，漫不经心地用拇指摩挲脖子上的护符。

“我跟另外几个人聊过。

人人都有秘密，对吧？我是说你们脖子上那些烙印。

我看不懂，可我听人说它们有含义。是给你们做过的事打的标记，或者别人说你们做过的事，对吧？

哥布林可不搞这么复杂的。谁要是做了坏事，他们拿石头把脑壳砸开，然后就完事。

|我说“他们”，不说“我们”，你也许注意到了。

我和哥布林已经没多少共同点了，而且很长时间都没有。以前确实有过，可后来这块护符把一切都改了。

你还记得吧，你找到我的时候，我记不得自己为什么会在那座神殿里？我刚跟这东西扯上关系的时候，也是那样。

这护符让我变聪明，你懂吧。我一变聪明，那些蠢念头就讲不通了。就像去读一堆刮痕，你甚至拿不准它们到底是不是字。

|我的意思是，我不记得这东西是怎么到我手里的。

哥布林确实能弄点粗浅魔法，这没错，可没复杂到魔法护符这种地步。就算他们能，我也不是法师，哥布林还不分享。更可能是有人给我的，或者我捡到的，或者偷的。

大概是最后那种。

我当然是在顺嘴编，可我猜想，我大概把某个可怜的老隐士脑袋砸开，拿走了他那条亮闪闪的项链。

|不管到底怎么回事，把这东西戴上之后，我就没法再跟哥布林一起过了。

我几乎没法跟他们说话，更别提跟他们处到一块儿。

从那以后，没有我能容下自己的地方，也没有让我觉得自己有归属的地方。

我不是说我就一定属于这里，可我觉得至少这儿的其他人也都觉得自己无处归属，这总算是点什么，对吧？

|所以就是这样。我的大秘密，或者说我有过的最像秘密的东西。

也许我还欠你当时那次救援，也许不欠。这个你来定，可我现在是为自己走下去，不是为你。咱们看看这会去到哪儿，嗯？”

Borfalgor 站起来。以这么小的生物来说，他的身姿出奇地庄重。他转向你。

“我在你的箱子里放了点东西。只是我找到的一件小东西。我本来打算自己留着，可是……我更愿意给你。就当我道谢的方式。

column1: People have been asking me to do things lately, coming to me and asking me to help them with chores, assigning me fire watches, bringing me on hunting parties. I think it means that they trust me, that they're expecting me to do my part like everybody else. It's a good feeling.
column2: 最近有人来找我做事，让我帮他们干杂活，派我守夜，带我去狩猎。我觉得这是信任我，是指望我跟大家一样出自己的那份力。这感觉很好。

column1: So that's it, huh? I ain't in a hurry to leave, but if you're done with me, I'll go.

column1: It really is quite remarkable to see people working together like this, especially in a place as ill-clouded as Lukatt. When I came here, I knew that I was likely to be walking alongside criminals, but I hadn't expected them to be so civil. I continue to learn new things each day.

column2: 这并不奇怪。我想你不会长久忍受一个十字军在背后盯着你。

column1:
May we speak? I awoke for my watch early, and could use the company. Besides, I wanted to discuss something.

I know I have mentioned that I came here on pilgrimage, as a test of my faith to my order, but what I never mentioned was that my decision was... influenced. 

The Crusaders have a purpose, a holy duty, to seek out evil and blasphemy and scourge it where we find it. It's the oath that I, and all Crusaders swear upon our appointment.

|I have been a Crusader for many years, and during that time, I did my duty faithfully and well, but there were some in the order who were... shall we say "dissatisfied" with my devotion.  

They said I was lax, that I was letting a soft heart sweeten my righteous purpose. The smith with whom I shared my breakfast in the morning was a sinner, the moments spent watching children run through the streets were indulgent, the flower I wore to honour a dead grandmother was vain, my stature was prideful. It never ended. 

One day I overheard the deacon talking with another crusader about me. I heard them saying that I was too well-liked by the people, and that I was dulling peoples' respect for the Crusaders as an order. Maybe they were even right. 

|What I heard next though, shocked me. They began to discuss setting me up for a murder, to publicly shame me and have me removed. 

I was furious, but they were both higher-ranking Crusaders than I, and I already well-outranked any town militia who would normally cover such things. There was nobody I could go to, no way to uncover their plot. 

I try to be a virtuous woman, but I am no paragon of cleverness. I couldn't think of anything else to do, so shortly afterward, I declared myself on holy pilgrimage, and the deacon, deliriously pleased with himself, sanctioned my pilgrimage, and named my destination Lukatt. 

|When I arrived, I wandered for a time with what scant supplies I had brought, and then eventually found my way to the Stillwind Abbey, where I very nearly flagellated all of those poor sisters over their love of handmade soaps and the storage of their foodstuff.

I realize now that I was angry. Angry at having been forced into this situation, and angry that I could do nothing to prevent it. Angry that my betters were the very villains I swore to oust, and angry that I abandoned my community to their rule. 

Though I have the motions very well-practiced, my faith was shaken to its very core, and perhaps, in some ways, it still is. Maybe it always will be. 

|I do not regret any of this, however.

If my faith was broken, it was only so I could pick out the pieces that should never have been there, and it is no small irony that I am finding peace and growth in the company of criminals. 

I am coming to know that I must be whole myself before I can hold the authority to judge others, and that knowledge has been most liberating. 

|Forgive me for prattling on so long. I'm sure you're eager to get to your bedroll. 

Only, have a look in your stash when you get an opportunity. It's no treasure to be sure, but I've left something there for you, as a token of my thanks. 

Goodnight.
column2:
我们能谈谈吗？我为了值守醒得早，正想有人作伴。再说，我有件事想谈谈。

我知道我说过，我来这里朝圣，是要考验我对修会的信仰，可我从没说过的是，这个决定……受到了影响。

十字军有一个宗旨，一份神圣的职责：寻出邪恶与亵渎，在何处找到，便在何处清除。这是我与所有十字军在受任时立下的誓言。

|我当十字军许多年了。那些年里，我忠实而妥善地履行了职责，可修会里有些人对我的虔诚……不妨说“不满意”。

他们说我松懈，说我让一颗软心肠冲淡了正义的宗旨。早晨与我共进早餐的铁匠是个罪人，看孩子们在街上跑的那些片刻是放纵，我为纪念亡故的祖母而戴的花是虚荣，我的仪态是傲慢。没完没了。

有一天，我听见执事和另一名十字军谈论我。我听见他们说，我太受人们喜爱，正在磨钝人们对十字军这个修会的尊敬。也许他们甚至是对的。

|可我接着听见的话，让我震惊。他们开始商量设下圈套，把一桩谋杀栽到我头上，当众羞辱我，再把我除名。

我怒不可遏，可他们两人都比我军衔高，而通常经手这种事的城镇民兵，军衔又都远低于我。我找不到可以去说的人，也没有办法揭穿他们的阴谋。

我努力做一个有德行的女人，可我不是聪明的典范。我想不出别的办法，于是不久之后，我宣布自己去进行神圣的朝圣。那位执事高兴得忘乎所以，批准了我的朝圣，并把目的地定为卢卡特。

|我到了以后，靠带来的那点微薄补给游荡了一阵，最终找到了静风修道院。我差点因为那些可怜的修女喜爱手工肥皂，以及她们存放食物的方式，把她们全部鞭笞一顿。

我现在明白，当时我在生气。气自己被逼进这种处境，气自己什么也阻止不了。气我的上级正是我发誓要铲除的恶人，气我把自己的社群丢给他们去统治。

尽管这些仪轨我行得极为熟练，我的信仰却已经动摇到了根上，也许在某些方面现在依然如此。也许永远都会如此。

|然而，这些我一概不后悔。

若我的信仰碎了，那也不过是为了让我拣出本不该在里面的碎片。而这讽刺可不小：我竟在罪犯的陪伴中找到了安宁与成长。

我渐渐明白，我必须先让自己完整，才有资格评判别人。这种认识，最是让人解脱。

|原谅我絮叨了这么久。你一定急着钻回铺盖里。

只是，有机会时看看你的存货。当然算不上什么宝物，可我在那里给你留了点东西，作为我谢意的信物。

晚安。

column1: This armour is heavier than it looks, you know, but lately it feels lighter. I don't know for certain why. Perhaps I've grown stronger, or perhaps something else has grown lighter. Coming to Lukatt was guaranteed to be interesting, but I hadn't expected it to be quite so enlightening.

column1: Perfect.

column1: The estate's a way off yet, of course. Bit of a hike, you see, but if yer ready to go, we'll be off.
column2: 庄园当然还有一段路。得走一截，明白吧，可你要是准备好了，咱们就出发。

column1: So, ya ready to go and see the magnificent Frico?
column2: 那么，准备好去见那位了不起的 Frico 了吗？

column1: Perfect, I'll show ya the way.
column2: 完美，我给你带路。

column1: Fine. I ain't goin' nowhere.
column2: 行。我哪儿也不去。

column1:
I can hear 'em, ya know."

Byrne sits down in front of the fire, the bloody red of his eyes glinting in the light. 

"Yer hearts, I mean. All of 'em. 

At first it was maddening, like they're all taunting me. I guess 'cuz I was mad. 

Goddamn Frico. 

|I got sent out here what... five, six years ago, maybe. 

Frico sprung me from the stocks back then. 

He was my hero at first, but, once he turned me, I was just a bitch to him. 

Just one more puppet to do his dirty work. 

I don't so much mind the vampire thing, really. A guy gets used to it. But, since Frico was the one who changed me, he had this kinda power over me.

|Saw him use it on another uppity sucker once, and it weren't pretty. Boiled him alive in his own skin. 

What a mess. 

I sure never would've been able to take him down on my own.

When I found ya, I was... gathering meat for him, and I hated it. 

Not for any special love for you, of course, just because I hated everything he wanted.

|He's dead now though, and I'm free as can be. 

Feels good.

All them beatin' hearts, sounds like frogs singing in the swamp to me now. 

It's the kinda song a fella could get used to."

Byrne turns toward you as a relaxed smile creeps across his lips.

"Ya set me free, so I'm with ya. Just say the word.
column2:
我听得见，你知道的。”

Byrne 在火前坐下，眼睛里那抹血红在火光中闪着。

“我说的是你们的心跳。每一颗都是。

起初简直要把人逼疯，好像全在嘲弄我。大概是因为我自己就疯着。

他妈的 Frico。

|我被送到这儿……大概五六年前吧。

那时 Frico 把我从枷场里弄了出来。

起初他是我的英雄，可他一把我转化了，我就只是他的婊子。

再多一个给他干脏活的傀儡。

吸血鬼这件事，我倒不太介意。一个男人会习惯的。可既然是 Frico 转化的我，他就对我有这种控制。

|我见过他拿这招对付另一个翘尾巴的吸血鬼，那可不漂亮。把他活活煮在他自己的皮里。

真够烂的。

我自己肯定永远打不倒他。

我找到你的时候，我正在……给他收集肉，我恨透了。

当然不是因为对你有什么特别的情分，只因为他要的一切我都恨。

|可他现在死了，我自由得不能再自由。

感觉真好。

那些跳动的心，现在听着像沼泽里青蛙在唱歌。

这种歌，一个汉子听得惯。”

Byrne 转向你，一丝放松的笑容慢慢爬上他的嘴角。

“你放我自由了，所以我跟着你。你吩咐一声就行。

column1: Ya know, I spent such a long time itching to get out from under Frico's thumb, so much time hating all of the stuff I didn't want to do, I never really thought about what I do want. I guess I'll have lots of time to figure it out.
column2: 你知道，我巴不得从 Frico 的手底下逃出来，盼了那么久，那么长时间恨着所有我不想干的事，从来没真正想过自己到底想要什么。大概我有的是时间去想明白。

column1: Ya don't need me? That's fine, I guess, as long as yer sure.
column2: 你不需要我？行吧，我想，只要你确定。

column1: It's a fuckin' beautiful day.
column2: 真是他妈美好的一天。

column1: Then I don't mind stickin' around.
column2: 那我留下来也无所谓。

column1: Then I'll go. Thanks fer everything.
column2: 那我走了。谢谢你的一切。

column1: You're gonna have a bad time.
column2: 你们要倒霉了。

column1: Follow my lead, lads!
column2: 跟我上，弟兄们！

column1: Look there.
column2: 看那儿。

column1: What's that, then?
column2: 那又是什么？

column1: Damn!
column2: 该死！

column1: You'll regret that!
column2: 你会后悔的！

column1: Aye?
column2: 嗯？

column1: Nothin'
column2: 没什么。

column1: To the last man!
column2: 战到最后一人！

column1: Stand fast and give 'em hell!
column2: 站稳，往死里打！

column1: Don't be daft!
column2: 别犯傻！

column1: Let me show you how it's done!
column2: 看我怎么干！

column1: If you aren't gonna fight, \nget out of the way!
column2: 你要是不打，\n就让开！

column1: We've no use for yellow bellies!
column2: 我们用不着软蛋！

column1: Push! We can still win!
column2: 压上去！还能赢！

column1: Fuck it!
column2: 操！

column1: I never mentioned this before, but this is quite a neat operation you've got here. Hell, you put together twenty people when I asked you to, and I think you could put together a lot more than that. Gives an old mind new things to think about.
column2: 我以前没说过，可你这摊子办得真利落。妈的，我让你凑二十个人，你就凑齐了，而且我觉得你还能再凑出好多。让我这把老脑子有新东西可想了。

column1: What? You're joking.
column2: 什么？你在开玩笑。

column1: Anything to report?
column2: 有什么要汇报的？

column1: I'm not going to try to take over your crew, you know. Just relax.
column2: 我不会来抢你的团伙，你知道。放轻松。

column1: You're not joking. Well, I'll just hunt down the Sud'umKatch on my own. Good luck.
column2: 你不是在开玩笑。那好，我自己去猎那头 Sud'umKatch。祝你好运。

column1: There's a way to defeat it. There has to be. We'll figure it out.
column2: 有办法打败它。一定有。我们会想出来的。

column1: And here I thought this was just an issue of the sea keeping us here. I never stopped to wonder why it was this island and not another one. We're sitting on top of a god damn Sud'umKatch. Of course we are. Why wouldn't we be? How did nobody know about this?
column2: 我还以为只是这片海把我们困在这儿。我从没停下来想过，为什么是这座岛，不是另一座。我们正坐在一头他妈的 Sud'umKatch 头顶上。当然是。怎么会不是？怎么就没人知道这件事？

column1: There are some basic supplies here, but nothing really worth lugging around, I think.
column2: 这儿有点基本补给，可我觉得没什么真正值得扛着走的。

column1: I'm anxious to leave. Been holed up here for too long.
column2: 我急着离开。窝在这儿太久了。

column1: I'll wait here until you've cleared a spot for me then. This is as good a place to wait as any.
column2: 那我就在这儿等，等你给我腾出位置。在这儿等，跟哪儿都一样。

column1:
You don't mind if I borrow your ear for a moment?"

Logus takes a stool beside you and gazes into the firelight, a tired expression stretched across his face.

"This may come as a surprise to you, but I was a naval captain before I was a Lukattite. For more than fifteen years, I sailed the waters between Crest and Tsarath, sometimes as a freighter, sometimes as a patrol. 

Nothing like it, being out on the water.
|Maybe I just got too cocky. Started thinking of the ship as mine, the crew as mine, the ocean as mine. 

I did my job, of course, but that became an afterthought.

I was often tasked with taking down pirates, but I often found ways to deal with them that didn't involve stringing them up. 

I was never specifically told to string them up, of course. Not at first, anyway, but when word got back to the nobility in Crest, they weren't too happy. 

I was reprimanded, given a stern warning and all, but you can imagine what I thought of that, I'm sure. 

|I kept doing things my way. I foolishly thought that there was nothing they could do about it. 

Eventually, they'd had enough, and put a sniffer in my crew.

We had on different hands all the time, so I thought nothing of it, really, but when we get back into port, they're waiting with guards, and this swabber turns around and puts me under arrest for defying the crown. What was I gonna say? I did defy the crown, didn't I?

|Well that was probably bad enough, but I fought them. My crew came to my side, or most of 'em did. 

It didn't matter. 

They beat us down, put me on trial, and executed nine of my sailors. They made me watch.

As for me, I'll give you three guesses as to what old Captain Logus' fate was. They wanted to make sure that all the other captains in their employ got the message loud and clear, and fell into line like trained hounds. 

|Well, I've been trying to find a way off this island ever since. I found that boat, but before you came along, I never managed to put together crew enough to actually sail it. 

Fat lot of good that did us. 

At least now we know our enemy, such as it is. I got no idea how we're gonna overcome a Sud'umKatch, but when you don't have any ideas, that's when you get creative, ain't it?

|Anyway, thanks. For everything. For getting me out of the shipyard, for lighting that beacon, for patching me up and bringing me along. 

You've done enough to prove to me that you're the stuff a real captain is made of, and for that, I salute you.
column2:
不介意听我说一会儿？”

Logus 在你身边拉过一张凳子，望着火光，脸上写满疲惫。

“这也许会让你吃惊，可在我成为卢卡特人之前，我是一名海军船长。我在克雷斯特与察拉思之间的水域航行了十五年有余，有时跑货运，有时跑巡逻。

出海的滋味，没有什么比得上。
|也许是我太自负了。开始觉得船是我的，船员是我的，大海也是我的。

我当然还在做事，可那已经退到脑后了。

我常常被派去剿海盗，可我往往能找到不必把他们吊死的办法。

当然，从来没人明确叫我把他们吊死。至少一开始没有。可话传到克雷斯特的贵族那里，他们不太高兴。

我被申斥了一顿，挨了严厉警告之类的，不过你肯定想象得出我对此怎么想。

|我照旧按自己的方式干。我愚蠢地以为他们拿我没办法。

终于，他们受够了，往我的船员里安了个眼线。

船上的人手一直在换，所以我真没当回事。可等我们进了港，他们带着卫兵等在那儿，这个擦甲板的转过身来，以违抗王权的罪名把我逮捕。我还能说什么？我的确违抗了王权，不是吗？

|那大概已经够糟了，可我还跟他们动了手。我的船员站到我这边，至少大部分人是这样。

没用。

他们把我们打趴下，把我送上法庭，处决了我的九名水手。他们逼我看着。

至于我，老船长 Logus 的下场，我给你猜三次。他们想让手下所有其他船长都把话听得明明白白，像训练好的猎犬一样乖乖归队。

|打那以后，我一直在找离开这座岛的办法。我找到了那艘船，可在你出现之前，我始终凑不齐真正能把它开走的船员。

结果对我们屁用没有。

至少现在我们知道敌人是什么了，尽管就这么个东西。我完全不知道要怎么战胜一头 Sud'umKatch，可正是没主意的时候，才该想出新办法，对不对？

|总之，谢谢。为了一切。为了把我弄出船厂，为了点亮那座灯塔，为了给我疗伤，还把我带在身边。

你做的这些，已经向我证明你是真正船长的料。为此，我向你致敬。

column1: This fucking island. There is something really weird happening here. It would be a lot easier to toss my hat into the sea and spend the rest of me days getting drunk at the shipyard. Ah well. This is more fun, probably. Nobody at the shipyard took me seriously anyway.
column2: 这他妈的岛。这儿真有古怪的事在发生。把帽子扔进海里，余下的日子在船厂喝个烂醉，会轻松得多。算了。这样大概更有意思。反正船厂没人把我当回事。

column1: You don't want me along anymore? If you're worried about my health, you shouldn't be.
column2: 你不想再带上我了？要是担心我的身体，那倒不必。

column1: Good to see you, mate. Come to chat?
column2: 见到你真好，伙计。来聊天？

column1: I might be past my prime, but an old orc is still a good thing to have on your side. Trust me.
column2: 我也许过了巅峰，可身边有个老兽人，仍是好事。相信我。

column1: Well, drinking by the sea it is, then. I wish you luck.
column2: 那好吧，就去海边喝酒。祝你好运。

column1: As long as you're alright with me waiting at the entrance, I'm with you wherever you go.
column2: 只要你不介意我在入口等着，你去哪儿我就跟到哪儿。

column1: Hi. We going out soon?
column2: 嗨。我们快出发了吗？

column1: Sure. Just give the word.
column2: 好。你吩咐一声就行。

column1: I've picked up how to make a lot of useful things. Take a look, see if I have anything you might need.
column2: 我学会了做不少有用的东西。看看吧，看有没有你用得上的。

column1: Looking to buy?
column2: 想买东西？

column1: It takes me a while to make new things, so you may not see me again for a while.
column2: 做新东西要花我一阵工夫，所以你可能有一段时间见不着我。

column1: I've a wide range of studies and knowledges, not the least of which is commerce. I shall advise the goings-on of merchants and the like. You'll find prices improved all around, and you'll have an easier time selling some of the more esoteric things you come across. Sounds useful, no?
column2: 我的学问和见识都很广，尤其是商业。商人一类人的动向，我会给你通报。你会发现各处的价钱都更合适，那些更冷僻的东西也好出手些。听着有用，对吧？

column1: A good day to you, darling. What assistance can I provide?
column2: 日安，亲爱的。我能帮上什么？

column1: Everybody gets a better deal this way, darling. Believe me.
column2: 这样人人都更划算，亲爱的。相信我。

column1: Flee now, or your lives are forfeit!
column2: 现在就逃，否则性命不保！

column1: Scatter them.
column2: 打散他们。

column1: Perhaps this will prove of some use.
column2: 也许这还有些用处。

column1: Is this significant?
column2: 这要紧吗？

column1: You are becoming tiresome.
column2: 你渐渐让人厌烦了。

column1: It is time for you to die.
column2: 是你去死的时候了。

column1: I doubt there is anything of significance here.
column2: 我不觉得这里有什么要紧的东西。

column1: I am here.
column2: 我在。

column1: A true test of my power!
column2: 这才是对我力量的真正考验！

column1: I cannot die, fool. Come.
column2: 我不会死，蠢货。来。

column1: Stand aside, \nand witness my power!
column2: 让开，\n见识我的力量！

column1: Surely you are not so pathetic.
column2: 你还不至于如此可悲。

column1: Fear is for the weak!
column2: 恐惧是弱者的事！

column1: Out of my way, coward.
column2: 别挡道，懦夫。

column1: All part of my design.
column2: 全在我的谋划之中。

column1: Most impressive.
column2: 令人叹服。

column1: Are you raising an army? Interesting. The machinations of mortals, while inevitably doomed to failure, are nonetheless entertaining to behold. I shall stay a while longer, to see what fruit your labour bears.
column2: 你在组建军队？有意思。凡人的算计纵然注定失败，看着倒也有趣。我再多留一阵，看看你的劳作能结出什么果实。

column1: If you no longer have need of me, I shall go. I have schemes of my own to attend.
column2: 你若不再需要我，我就离开。我自己还有图谋要料理。

column1: What is it you desire?
column2: 你想要什么？

column1: A wise choice. I am an asset that could not be easily replaced.
column2: 明智的选择。我这样的助力，不容易替换。

column1: Farewell then, mortal. We shall not meet again.
column2: 那么永别了，凡人。我们不会再相见。

column1: You are impressive. What would you have of me?
column2: 你令人刮目相看。你要我做些什么？

column1: You overstep your bounds, fool!
column2: 你越界了，蠢货！

column1: Yes, a fair bargain, I should think. Take your trophy.
column2: 不错，我看这笔买卖公平。拿走你的战利品。

column1: You will have to do better than that if you expect me to serve the likes of you!
column2: 你若指望我侍奉你这种人，就得做得比这更好！

column1: Very well. You have earned my service.
column2: 很好。你赢得了我的侍奉。

column1: The day, then, is yours.
column2: 那么，这一天归你了。

column1: I shall aid you then, for as long as it pleases me to do so. Direct me.
column2: 那我就助你，直到我不再乐意为止。吩咐吧。

column1: A brave one, are you? Not many would dare to approach one such as I, let alone share their words, but fear not. If my business involved you, you would well know it.
column2: 你倒挺大胆？敢靠近我这等存在的不多，更别说还来交谈，不过不必怕。我的事若与你有关，你自然会知道。

column1: Begone, lest you rouse my temper.
column2: 退去，免得惹我动怒。

column1: An alliance with you? How amusing. Still, there is always a use for overeager fools. Perhaps it will serve my interests.
column2: 与你结盟？真有趣。不过，过分热心的蠢货总有用处。也许这符合我的利益。

column1: A coward after all? Predictable. Extricate yourself.
column2: 到底还是个懦夫？不出所料。自行退去。

column1:
You are a most unusual being. When I agreed to serve you, I expected little more than a trite amusement, but now I find myself embroiled in your struggles. It is not often that I learn something unexpected of mortals and the workings of their minds, but this occasion has been most... informative. 

I have decided to offer a pact of servitude. Your goals shall be my goals. 

Let us see them done.
column2:
你是个极为不寻常的存在。我答应侍奉你的时候，原以为不过是个乏味的消遣，现在却发现自己卷进了你的争斗。我很少能从凡人身上、从他们心智的运作里得知意料之外的事，可这一回着实……大有收获。

我决定提出一份侍奉之约。你的目标便是我的目标。

让我们去把它们办成。

column1: It has been long since I have walked alongside a mortal Lord. To see our enemies tremble in terror at my power, and to see their eyes acknowledge your command of such majesty, it is delectable.
column2: 我已经很久不曾与一位凡间领主并肩而行。看着我们的敌人在我的力量前恐惧颤抖，看着他们的眼睛承认如此威严由你驾驭，真是美味。

column1: If I leave, I shall not return while you draw breath. Are you quite certain?
column2: 我若离开，只要你还喘着气，我就不会回来。你真的确定？

column1: Yes, my Lord?
column2: 是，我的领主？

column1: It is only natural you would fear the power of a being such as I. Such is the plight of man.
column2: 你畏惧我这等存在的力量，再自然不过。这便是人类的处境。

column1: Then, I shall watch this unfold from afar. I know you will not disappoint me.
column2: 那么，我就远远看着这一切展开。我知道你不会让我失望。

column1: Oh don't you worry, nobody gives me any lip. Any that do get a real rude awakening. I keep a close eye on the supplies, make sure nobody gets greedy. I can watch over stuff you wanna keep for later, and I can see to selling off the stuff you don't. Just leave it to me.
column2: 哦，你别担心，没人敢跟我顶嘴。敢顶的，会吃不了兜着走。我盯紧补给，不让任何人起贪心。你想留到以后的东西，我能看着；你不要的，我也能帮你卖掉。交给我就行。

column1: What is it dear?
column2: 什么事，亲爱的？

column1: Take care of yourself.
column2: 照顾好自己。

column1: Oh don't worry about a thing. I'll have the injured back on their feet in no time with my cutting-edge medical procedures.
column2: 哦，什么都别担心。凭我那些最先进的医疗手段，伤员很快就能重新站起来。

column1: Would you like some leeches?
column2: 要来几条水蛭吗？

column1: Yes, just leave it to me.
column2: 好，交给我就行。

column1: Fear not. None shall perish under my care. I hear the thrumming of the pulse of the world, the drum that beats the rhythm of life. I shall guide the injured to wellness again.
column2: 不必害怕。在我的照料下，不会有人死去。我听得见世界脉搏的震响，那面敲出生命节律的鼓。我会引导伤者再次痊愈。

column1: Yes, child? Can I help with something?
column2: 怎么了，孩子？有什么我能帮的？

column1: Go with the wind at your back.
column2: 愿风在你身后。

column1: The creature's attention is fixated on you.
column2: 这只生物的注意力钉在你身上。

column1: Would you like to permanently release the creature?
column2: 你想永久放走这只生物吗？

column1: The creature has noticed you.
column2: 这只生物注意到你了。

column1: The creature leaves.
column2: 这只生物离开了。

column1: The creature hesitates in its assault.
column2: 这只生物在进攻时犹豫了。

column1: The creature does not understand, and resumes its assault.
column2: 这只生物不明白，继续进攻。

column1: The creature drops something and flees the battle.
column2: 这只生物扔下一样东西，逃离了战斗。

column1: The creature submits, and accepts your control over it.
column2: 这只生物屈服了，接受你对它的控制。

column1: The creature flees the battle.
column2: 这只生物逃离了战斗。

column1: The creature responds to your commands.
