Oh deary me, trying to steal from my collection are we. Just because you thought you killed me, you think that this place now belongs to you? While I may not be a fighter, I have survived here for quite a while.	哎呀呀，想偷我的收藏是吧。就因为你们以为把我杀了，就觉得这地方现在归你们了？我也许不会打架，可我在这儿活了相当久了。
There you go. Everything else in here is too sentimental for me to part with, and wouldn't be useful to you anyhow. So please just leave and never come back.	拿去吧。这里其余的东西我都太有感情，舍不得撒手，对你们反正也没用。所以请离开，永远别再回来。
Very good, very good. Now wait here a tick, will you? You're going to like this.	很好，很好。在这儿稍等片刻，好吗？你们会喜欢这个的。
Well, I know better than to fight when I'm outmatched. If you let me go, I'll give you some good things from my plunders. What do you say?	唉，打不过的时候我可不会硬打。你们放我走，我就从掠来的东西里拿几件好的给你们。怎么样？
... I don't intend to let your shoulders go cold ever again.	……我再也不打算让你的肩膀受凉了。
Am I going mad with worry? Perhaps. Are they dreams, or are they visions? Perhaps this is Leviathan sending me madness to punish my lapse.	我是忧心得快疯了吗？也许吧。那是梦，还是异象？也许是 Leviathan 降下疯狂，惩罚我的失职。
And... it's not without its appeals.	而且……这种生活也不是全无吸引力。
Another life I'm glad to be rid of. This life is harder, but it's real.	另一段人生，我很高兴已经摆脱了。这种生活更难，但它是真的。
Echo through ...... our love	回响穿过……，我们的爱
Generations ago, long before the days of my grandmother's mother, Lukatt was a hive of beasts and worse. Orcs and men came to conquer it, but no matter how ferociously they struggled, the island always brought them low.	数代以前，远在我祖母的母亲所处的年月之前，卢卡特是野兽与更糟之物的巢窟。兽人与人类前来征服，可无论他们如何凶猛地挣扎，这座岛总能把他们击垮。
Gloried one ...... sea	荣耀者……海
Gloried... he... hear... voices... echo... love	荣耀……他……听……声音……回响……爱
He mouths the same word over and over again. Bertan. Pertan. Mortan. Purtan. I can't make it out clearly. Why does it seem so important?	他一遍遍用口型念着同一个词。Bertan。Pertan。Mortan。Purtan。我辨不清楚。它为什么显得如此重要？
Hear our voices, ...... above	听我们的声音，……上方
I have revealed the secret to two others before now: my Lord-husband, and my prime minister. They strive now to find some way to appease Leviathan and spare us all. Hopefully the focus on me and my deeds will afford them some fortune.	在此之前，我已把这秘密透露给另外两人：我的夫君主上，以及我的首相。他们此刻正竭力寻找办法安抚 Leviathan，好放过我们所有人。希望众人的目光集中在我和我的所作所为上，能给他们带来一些运气。
I hold a secret forbidden to ever pass my lips, but this telling of it shall be my third. I only hope that by the time someone finds this regretful tome, its knowledge will be unnecessary.	我守着一个永不许说出口的秘密，而这一次讲述将是第三回。我只希望，等有人找到这本满载悔恨的典籍时，其中的知识已经不必再用。
I remember how much pain you were in. A stone that large might've killed you!	我记得你那时有多疼。那么大一块石头，说不定会要了你的命！
I see a man's body, perfect in every way, but broken into many pieces, black and glittering. His head, broken away from his body tries to speak, but no air passes his lips.	我看见一个男人的身体，处处完美，却碎成许多片，漆黑而闪光。他的头颅脱离了躯体，试图开口，可没有气息通过他的嘴唇。
I was sewing a cloak for you. To keep your shoulders warm when I could not. It is unfinished, but...	我在给你缝一件斗篷。在我没法陪在你身边的时候，让你的肩膀暖和。还没缝完，不过……
I was. Please, take it!	是的。请收下！
Id krav oraidumten, Nazar.	Id krav oraidumten，Nazar。
If they fail, then I will have truly been the queen to destroy Lukatt, in a far fuller sense than anyone can imagine. Lord Leviathan, have mercy upon us.	倘若他们失败，我便真正成了毁灭卢卡特的女王，其意义远比任何人想象的更为彻底。主 Leviathan，怜悯我们。
In return, Leviathan would allow his chosen few, the Lukattites, to flourish, to build upon the island, and he would protect and nurture them as a part of the island itself.	作为回报，Leviathan 会允许他拣选的少数人，即卢卡特人，繁荣昌盛，在岛上兴建，并保护他们、滋养他们，把他们当作岛屿本身的一部分。
It couldn't... you mean all that time you were sick, you... you were holding a Bogani stone? For me...?	不可能……你是说你生病的那些日子里，你……你一直留着一块 Bogani 石？为了我……？
It is a stone of my own flesh, and it is my promise of faith \nto you. Accept it, and I will belong to you evermore, in flesh and blood, in love and war. I desire no other.	这是我自身血肉凝成的石头，也是我向你立下的忠贞之誓。\n接受它，我便永远属于你，在血肉之中，在爱与战争之中。我不要别人。
It's so peaceful here. Like nothing bad ever happened here at all.	这里好平静。仿佛从来没有坏事发生过。
It's so warm. I don't know what to say! I never imagined somebody would think me worthy of something like this. How can I possibly repay this?	好温暖。我不知道该说什么！我从没想过有人会觉得我配得上这样的东西。我该怎么偿还？
It's yes, you fool! That was our last kiss as idle lovers.	我答应，你这傻瓜！那是我们还只做恋人时的最后一吻。
Leviathan will be angered, and this island will be doomed.	Leviathan 会发怒，这座岛将注定毁灭。
Lord Leviathan ......	主 Leviathan……
Many Lukattites call for my blood, and my words are widely mocked as lies. If I am killed, the bargain will go unhonoured. If I reveal this secret to my people, they will think that I am spinning a fantastic yarn to save my own head.	许多卢卡特人喊着要我的血，我的话也被到处嘲笑成谎言。我若遇害，这约定便无人履行。我若向我的人民揭开这秘密，他们会以为我在编造奇谈，只为保住自己的脑袋。
Maxim is mounting an expedition at his hunting lodge in Pagewood, hoping to treat with Leviathan himself, and Fastad has retreated to his archive in Bracewind to search for other solutions. All of my hopes rest on them.	Maxim 正在他侍从林的狩猎行馆集结一支远征，希望亲自与 Leviathan 交涉；Fastad 则退入他在布雷斯温德的档案馆，寻找别的办法。我全部的希望都寄于他们。
Nazar, it's beautiful. Thank you.	Nazar，它真美。谢谢你。
Never. Not when the end of the day promised me back to you.	不会。一天的尽头总会把我送回你身边。
Since meeting you, I have thought of little else. Whatever happens here, whatever becomes of this island, I don't ever want to lose you.	自从遇见你，我几乎没想过别的。无论这里发生什么，无论这座岛变成什么样，我永远不想失去你。
The greatest of the terrors was Leviathan, his coils tangled around every reef and shoal. The island belonged to him, and he would not lightly release it.	诸恐怖之中最可怖的是 Leviathan，他的躯体盘绕缠住每一处礁石与浅滩。这座岛属于他，他不会轻易松手。
The hero, Chevre, went low into the bowels of the island, and there, he struck a bargain with the lord of the island's monsters. Rites, sacrifices, festivals in his honour, those were the promises made.	英雄 Chevre 向下走入岛屿的脏腑，在那里与岛上怪物之主订下约定。仪式、献祭、奉他之名的节庆，这些便是许下的诺言。
This bargain was kept secret, so as to prevent our enemies from interfering with it, and its terms were passed from Chevre, who became the island's first king, to each monarch in succession. Now, the burden of this bargain rests with me.	这约定被保密，以免敌人插手，其条款由后来成为岛上第一位国王的 Chevre 传给其后每一位君主。如今，这约定的重担落在我身上。
This kingdom is fallen, and my people torn. My life is in danger, so I have fled here, to the cloister I once lived as a young girl. Even here is not safe, however, and soon, nowhere will be safe.	这个王国已经倾覆，我的人民四分五裂。我的生命处于危险之中，于是我逃到这里，逃到我少女时代住过的隐修院。然而即便这里也不安全，很快，任何地方都不会安全。
This kiss shall be as your husband.	这一吻，便是以你丈夫的身份。
What is your answer then?	那么，你的答复是什么？
What's this?	这是什么？
Yeah. There are some things on this island that make all of the bad stuff seem really far away. Like another life.	是啊。这岛上有些东西，能让所有糟糕的事显得非常遥远。像是另一段人生。
You can repay it by laying with me every night and standing with me every day, until time or battle takes us.	你可以这样偿还：每夜与我同床，每日与我并肩，直到时间或战斗把我们带走。
You... you what?	你……你说什么？
all time	一切时光
commands the	号令这片
dry	干燥的
high	高高的
in sunken	在沉没之
is he	即是他
praised be	应受赞美
the brine	卤水
And thanks.	还有，谢谢。
Bigs! Bigs coming! Protect King!	大个子！大个子来了！保护国王！
I've got to get out of this place. As for you, sack it, loot it, claim it, or burn it to the ground for all I care. If there's anything of use to you, it's all yours. I just want out.	我得离开这地方。至于你们，洗劫、搜刮、占下，或者烧成白地，我都不管。要是有什么对你们有用，都归你们。我只想出去。
It worked, I suppose, for they were certainly in awe of me, but then they dragged me back here and said I was their king. They didn't ever plan to let me leave, and there were far more than I could hope to overcome alone, so I had no choice but to play along.	我想这奏效了，他们确实对我十分敬畏，可接着就把我拖回这里，说我是他们的国王。他们根本没打算放我走，人数也远不是我一个人能对付的，我别无选择，只能顺着演下去。
My name is Shapiro, and I am... or was... a professor of sorcery. When I came under attack by these creatures, naturally I used my sorcery to defend myself.	我叫 Shapiro，我是……或者说曾经是……一名巫术教授。这些生物袭击我的时候，我自然用巫术自卫。
Oh thank the Gods. Did you get them all?	哦，感谢诸神。你们把他们都解决了？
Rest assured, I have no love for these diminuitive savages, and I was never their king.	请放心，我对这帮矮小的野蛮人毫无感情，我也从来不是他们的国王。
If there was anyone I'd want to see just one more time, Max, it would be you.	如果这世上还有谁是我想再看一眼的，Max，那就是你。
Max. I remember when these sculptures were made. You probably think I'm lying, but the sculptor really didn't exaggerate much.	Max。我记得这些雕塑是什么时候做的。你大概觉得我在撒谎，可雕刻的人真的没怎么夸张。
Anyway, can I have it? I'm the only one with any chance of withstanding the pure darkness of that cake, after all.	总之，能给我吗？毕竟，只有我还有机会承受那块蛋糕纯粹的黑暗。
But, of course!	那当然！
Dark arcane secrets, what else?	黑暗的奥术秘密，还能是什么？
I really thought the cake would be chocolate, though. Strange.	我本来真以为那蛋糕是巧克力的。奇怪。
I'm uniquely-suited and such.	我是独一无二的合适人选，之类的。
It isn't working! It's rebellious! Like the darkness has a will of its own!	不行！它在反抗！就像那黑暗有自己的意志！
Just get your rod, and let's go.	把法杖拿上，我们走。
Let's see what this rod can do!	看看这法杖能干什么！
Man was not meant to know chocolate as dark as this!	人类本不该知晓如此黑暗的巧克力！
My moment of weakness is past. Best that you carry the cake back to the stronghold though, lest I be tempted.	我软弱的那一刻已经过去了。不过蛋糕最好由你带回据点，免得我又受诱惑。
No matter. It is only a matter of time before its secrets bend to my will. Let's be off.	无妨。它的秘密向我的意志屈服，不过是时间问题。我们走。
Oh no! While we were screwing around with that cake, some trolls wandered up!	哦不！我们正拿那块蛋糕瞎折腾，几头巨魔晃过来了！
Oh, drat! I got so caught up in the excitement of battle, I completely forgot to pick up the rod!	哦，可恶！我让战斗的兴奋冲昏了头，彻底忘了把法杖捡起来！
Oh, no no no. You can't feel it? Look at this masterpiece!	哦，不，不，不。你感觉不到吗？看看这件杰作！
Oh, they'll be sorry they came this way today.	哦，他们今天挑这条路会后悔的。
Perhaps, in the end, that is the wiser choice. Who knows what could happen if I unraveled the moist, dark secrets of that eldritch wonder?	也许，到头来这才是更明智的选择。谁知道，倘若我揭开那件诡秘奇物那些湿润、黑暗的秘密，会发生什么？
Right. Well. Let's go then.	行。嗯。那我们走吧。
Rosewood Teahouse Menu	玫瑰木茶馆菜单
Seriously? Lots of people back at the stronghold would love to have some cake too. I get that you're desperate for it, but really, I thought you'd be more willing to share.	认真的？据点里好多人也会想吃点蛋糕。我知道你馋得要命，可我真以为你更愿意跟人分。
So you intend to deny me the power, then?	所以你是打算不把这力量给我了？
Such magnificent power!	如此宏伟的力量！
The loft! The crumb! The heady aroma! The fine, pure cocoa! It's positively bewitching!	那蓬松！那碎屑！那醉人的香气！那细腻纯粹的可可！简直令人着魔！
This is the weirdest thing I've seen since we got here. Even when compared to that thing with the face.	这是我们到这儿以来见过最怪的东西。就算跟那个长着脸的东西比，也是。
This rod contains all of the power of that cake. I'm sure we'll be able to find a way to turn its power toward the greater good.	这根法杖蕴含着那块蛋糕的全部力量。我相信我们能找到办法，把这力量用于更大的善。
This thing could make enough cake to feed everybody forever!	这东西做出来的蛋糕，够所有人一直吃到永远！
Unbelievable! To think that this was just sitting here all these years!	难以置信！想不到它就这么在这儿搁了这么多年！
Unbelieveable!	难以置信！
Wait, Greening, what are you doing?	等等，Greening，你要干什么？
Watch, I'll make a gigantic one right now!	看着，我现在就做一个巨大的！
What the hell was that?	刚才那他妈的是什么？
What's wrong?	怎么了？
What? It's just a cake.	什么？不就是块蛋糕。

column1: Yikes, Green, if it's really that important to you, then take it.
column2: 我的天，Green，既然这对你真那么要紧，那就拿去吧。

column1: You'd better not forget it after all the fuss you made to get it. Go pick it up!
column2: 你闹出那么大动静才弄到它，可别回头就忘了。去拿！

column1: Breathtaking harmony heard the isle over! Come and treat your ears to the Royal Seamen's Chorus, playing all week!
column2: 全岛都听得见的惊人和声！来让你们的耳朵享享福吧，皇家水手合唱团，演满一整周！

column1: I had to fire one of the guards today. He tried to get Odluk to escape, but the old orc told on him and refused to go. I did everything by the book on this one, but... I don't know. If I was Odluk, I'd have gone. He spends more time in the cell than he does at home with that awful wife he loves so much.
column2: 我今天不得不开除一名卫兵。他想帮 Odluk 逃走，可那老兽人告发了他，不肯走。这件事我完全照章办了，可是……我不知道。我要是 Odluk，我早走了。他待在牢房里的时间，比待在家里陪那个他那么爱的可恶老婆还长。

column1: I have given my response already. Though I was born in Crest, Lukatt is now my home, and I will not abandon it, nor sell it to you to use as a wedge against the orc nation. If you do not remove your provocateurs, my next missive to you shall be writ in steel.
column2: 我已经给过答复。我虽生于克雷斯特，卢卡特如今已是我的家。我不会抛弃它，也不会把它卖给你，供你用作对付兽人国度的楔子。你若不撤走挑衅者，我下一封信将用钢铁写成。

column1: I'd get audiences used to the idea of a clothed singing werewolf before you try to get them on board with a naked one.
column2: 我会先让观众习惯一只穿着衣服唱歌的狼人，再试着说服他们接受一只光着的。

column1: I've arranged your passage already. Please, sail for Tsarath and do not return. I know you want to try to calm things down in court, but this country is heading for disaster and you can not stop it. I beg you, flee while you can.
column2: 我已经替你安排好了船。求你，驶向察拉思，不要回来。我知道你想在宫廷里把事情平息，可这个国家正在走向灾难，你阻止不了。我求你，能走就走。

column1: It must have been exciting to perform for a crowd this big. You could fit hundreds of people in this courtyard!
column2: 给这么一大群人演出一定很带劲。这院子装得下几百人！

column1: Maybe I should think about performing naked.
column2: 也许我该考虑光着身子演出。

column1: Maybe. Probably would've been an exciting show if they did.
column2: 也许吧。他们要真那么干，大概会是一场很带劲的演出。

column1: This is the third time this month. I feel bad for the guy. He's always so apologetic and polite. His wife obviously doesn't give a damn, and she's just abusing this system to do whatever she wants without consequence. Is there seriously nothing we can do?
column2: 这个月第三次了。我替这家伙难受。他总是那么会道歉，那么有礼貌。他老婆显然一点都不在乎，只是在滥用这套规矩，想怎样就怎样，没有半点后果。我们真的什么都做不了吗？

column1: Today an orc I never saw before came to the cell instead of Odluk. I looked into it, and it turns out that Odluk died in an accident at home a few days ago. People are saying it's a suicide. Suicide my ass. That pig bitch killed him, whether she drove the knife herself or not.
column2: 今天来牢房的是个我从没见过的兽人，不是 Odluk。我查过了，Odluk 几天前在家中意外死了。人们说是自杀。自杀个屁。是那头猪婊子杀的他，不管刀是不是她亲手捅下去的。

column1: Yeah, probably good advice.
column2: 是啊，大概是好建议。

column1: You.. uh.. you don't really think the Royal Seamen's Chorus performed naked, do you?
column2: 你……呃……你不会真觉得皇家水手合唱团光着身子演过吧？

column1: Is it you, who dares stir my flames and then quench them? I will not stand for such trifling! Meet your doom, mortal fools!
column2: 是你吗，竟敢撩起我的火焰，又把它浇灭？我不会容忍这种戏弄！受死吧，凡人蠢货！

column1: , he thinks.
column2: ，他心想。

column1: I bet they were so happy. Orc men are always excited at their weddings.
column2: 我敢说他们当时高兴极了。兽人男人在自己的婚礼上总是兴奋得很。

column1: I'm sorry I made stupid decisions that utterly ruined you
column2: 对不起，我做了那些蠢决定，把你彻底毁了

column1: Looks like a wedding. An orc wedding, judging by the torches. Amazing that it's still standing after all this time.
column2: 看着像一场婚礼。从火把判断，是兽人的婚礼。过了这么久还立着，真了不起。

column1: I implore you to cease your operations here and leave. The pursuit of learning the demon's chaotic powers can only be described as foolish. Your attempts thus far have ended in failure, and I know not how much longer my magic will be effective in restraining it.
column2: 我恳求你停止在此地的行事并离开。追逐恶魔的混乱之力，只能称之为愚蠢。你至今的尝试皆以失败告终，我亦不知我的魔力还能压制它多久。

column1: I will not see you risk your life, or the lives of my fellow clergymen, nor shall I be held accountable should the demon run amok. To this end, I hereby dismiss myself from this parish. I can only hope that you would do the same. -- Pastor Nikolai
column2: 我不愿见你以性命冒险，也不愿见我的神职同僚以性命冒险，更不愿在恶魔肆虐时承担罪责。为此，我特此退出本堂区。我只能希望你也如此。——Nikolai牧师

column1: Pastor Evans. By your request, I have once again sealed away the demon which lurks inside this chamber. If you are reading this note, I assume you have come to release it again.
column2: Evans牧师。应你所请，我再次封印了潜伏于此室中的恶魔。你若读到这字条，我便假定你又是来释放它的。

column1: grounds maintenance
column2: 场地维护

column1: After you. Just in case.
column2: 你先请。以防万一。

column1: Anyway, we'll split the take. I open doors, you break skulls. See you!
column2: 总之，收获对半分。我开门，你砸脑袋。回头见！

column1: Approaching The Great Matthaxus is not permitted. Only the fathers may speak directly to his worship. If you've questions, speak to the fathers.
column2: 不许靠近伟大的 Matthaxus。只有神父可以直接对尊驾说话。有问题，去问神父。

column1: By Matthaxus' command, you are ordered to leave. Walk away now.
column2: 奉 Matthaxus 之命，命令你们离开。现在就走。

column1: Fortunately, they told me how to open the door already. Funny, huh? All you have to do is repeat their stupid bullshit back at them and they think you're the best thing ever.
column2: 幸好，他们已经告诉我怎么开门了。好笑吧？你只要把他们那些蠢屁话原样复述一遍，他们就觉得你是天底下最了不起的。

column1: Hey that's great! Now I don't have to share this stuff I swiped from the barracks. Just keep whatever it was you found, eh? Sounds like you worked for it.
column2: 嘿，太好了！这下我不用分我从兵营顺来的东西了。你找到的你留着，啊？听着你也是出力换的。

column1: I thought this looked familiar. I've been here. Was here for a few weeks, actually. They're a cult who worships some kind of... I don't know, God or Demon or something named Matthaxus. I left because they were too freaky for me to deal with on my own.
column2: 我就觉得眼熟。我来过。其实待了好几个星期。他们是个邪教，崇拜一个叫 Matthaxus 的……我也不知道，神还是恶魔。我离开是因为他们邪得我一个人应付不来。

column1: I'm Rosaline. Thanks for the help. Now I can fuck off with the loot and not worry about some dragon cult hunting me down and exacting vengeance. Yikes.
column2: 我是 Rosaline。谢你帮忙。现在我可以带着赃物滚蛋，不用担心什么龙教团追上来报仇。吓死人。

column1: I'm gonna see if there's any food worth taking before I head out. Later!
column2: 走之前我看看有没有值得拿走的吃的。回头见！

column1: Okay so here's the deal. Now that you've started shit, this whole place is going to come down. That's good, it's convenient. What do you say we make a detour through the fathers' quarters and mop up some of their valuables, hmm?
column2: 好，是这样。既然你已经把事闹炸了，这整地方都要垮。那也好，省事。咱们绕道去神父们的住处，把值钱的扫荡一通，怎么样？

column1: That sounded a bit ugly, but you made it out in more or less one piece I see? Find anything good in there?
column2: 听着有点难看，不过你大体还是整个人出来了？里面有什么好东西吗？

column1: There, it's open. Piece of cake.
column2: 好了，开了。小菜一碟。

column1: They have a room in the back that I always thought must be totally packed with treasure. We can check it out, if you want. I figured out how to pop their door locks while I was here, but never got a chance to actually do it.
column2: 他们后面有个房间，我一直觉得肯定堆满了财宝。你想看的话，咱们可以去。我在这儿的时候琢磨出了怎么撬开他们的门锁，可一直没机会真做。

column1: Ugh, don't you just hate it when you bust your ass for the big take and it's not even that great? Happens all the damn time. Tough break I guess.
column2: 呃，拼命就为了那笔大的，结果根本没多好，你不烦吗？他妈的老这样。算倒霉吧。

column1: Well, that was annoying. Do you have any idea how long it took to get them to let me in here? Oh well. I've wanted to do that a few times myself over the last week or so, but you're much better at cracking heads than I am.
column2: 哎，真烦。你知道我花了多久才让他们放我进来吗？算了。过去大概一周我也想这么干好几次，可砸脑袋你比我在行得多。

column1: Well, that was fun. Now, I've never seen this Matthaxus before. I bet they just made it up to scare people. Shall we find out?
column2: 嘿，挺好玩。话说我从没见过这个 Matthaxus。我赌是他们编出来吓人的。咱们去看看？

column1: You go on in first. Let me know what you find. I can barely carry all the junk I took from the fathers' rooms anyway.
column2: 你先进去。找到什么告诉我。反正神父房间里那些杂物我都快拿不动了。

column1: You were warned! Come brothers! Matthaxus calls upon us to defend him from these intruders!
column2: 已经警告过你们！来吧，兄弟们！Matthaxus 召唤我们，护他免受这些闯入者伤害！

column1: I'll have a look at that, if you don't mind!
column2: 你不介意的话，我来瞧瞧！

column1: Idum! This is why you shower me with praise and sexual favors.
column2: Idum！所以你才该拿夸奖和性好处浇我一身。

column1: Looks pretty basic. I'll have this bad boy wide open faster than a milkmaid at mayfair.
column2: 看着挺简单。我把这宝贝撬开，比五月集市上的挤奶姑娘张腿还快。

column1: Thanks, Peregrine. I'll keep that in mind.
column2: 谢了，Peregrine。我会记着。

column1: You really should consider showering your number-one thief with sexual favors, you know. Just a helpful tip.
column2: 你真该考虑用性好处犒劳你的头号贼，知道吧。只是个有用的建议。

column1: A secret tunnel like this could have any number of uses. What makes you think it was for sex?
column2: 这样的密道用途多了去了。你凭什么觉得是用来做爱的？

column1: Ah, sorry. Didn't mean to drag up bad vibes.
column2: 啊，抱歉。不是故意把不痛快翻出来。

column1: Ah, well. Not quite as exciting, but still pretty cool.
column2: 啊，好吧。没那么刺激，不过还是挺妙。

column1: Come see me later, Babe. We'll see if we can get that stick out of your butt.
column2: 回头来找我，宝贝。咱们看看能不能把你屁股里那根棍子拔出来。

column1: Grant, you're ruining my sex fantasy.
column2: Grant，你毁了我的性幻想。

column1: Hah!
column2: 哈！

column1: I am a warrior, not an Incubus. Spend more time on your knives, and less on my ass.
column2: 我是战士，不是梦魔。多花点时间在你的刀上，少花在我的屁股上。

column1: I can still enjoy it vicariously. Let me watch you do it sometime and we're even.
column2: 我还可以看着过过瘾。哪天让我看你做，咱们就两清。

column1: I could go for one of those right about now.
column2: 我现在还真想来一发。

column1: I don't know Beau, you'd be surprised at the lengths people will go to.
column2: 这我可不知道，Beau，人为了这个能走多远，你会吃惊的。

column1: I know, right?
column2: 可不是嘛？

column1: I think you're full of it.
column2: 我觉得你满嘴放屁。

column1: I was thinking more a late night snack.
column2: 我想的更像是深夜加餐。

column1: I wouldn't be surprised. Even when we were all doing it, and we all knew about it, the men I worked with at the labour camp loved their sneaking around.
column2: 我不意外。就算我们人人都在干，人人都知道，劳作营里跟我一起干活的男人还是喜欢偷偷摸摸。

column1: It seems like hiding a secret tunnel would be harder than hiding a secret affair.
column2: 藏一条密道，似乎比藏一段私情更难。

column1: It's been a long, long time since I've been able to do that.
column2: 我已经很久很久没能那么做了。

column1: Just let me have my fun, alright?
column2: 就让我乐乐，行不行？

column1: Leftie, you show me a bottle of whiskey and we'll talk.
column2: Leftie，你拿出一瓶威士忌，咱们再谈。

column1: More like contraband. Secret liquor party tunnel.
column2: 更像走私货。秘密酒会地道。

column1: Nice thought, I guess. You really think so?
column2: 想法倒是不错。你真这么想？

column1: No, wait. Don't answer that. I forgot who I was talking to. How foolish of me.
column2: 不，等等。别回答。我忘了在跟谁说话。我真蠢。

column1: No. The look on your face, however, was quite serious.
column2: 不。不过你脸上的神情相当认真。

column1: Not quite as fun, but I can still get into it.
column2: 没那么有意思，不过我还是能玩进去。

column1: Oh God, you're right. I'm seeing it now... the visions!
column2: 天哪，你说得对。我看见了……那些幻象！

column1: Oh, how romantic! Sneaking out in the dark of night, leaving your husband sleeping in bed, and shagging the stable boy!
column2: 哦，多浪漫！趁夜黑溜出去，丈夫还在床上睡着，然后把马夫小伙给上了！

column1: Oh, so was I.
column2: 哦，我也是。

column1: On what? If we're going to make camp here, I need to know where the rut-roads are.
column2: 专心什么？我们要是在这儿扎营，我得知道那些干炮的路在哪儿。

column1: Ooh, a secret passage? Handy for a late night rut, eh?
column2: 哦，密道？深夜干一炮挺方便吧？

column1: Or'pid noct.
column2: Or'pid noct。

column1: Right now?
column2: 现在？

column1: Right, you guys are all embarrassed about that. Weird.
column2: 对哦，你们全为这个害臊。奇怪。

column1: Right. A bit strange, but whatever.
column2: 行。有点怪，不过随便。

column1: Saved it. Nice.
column2: 记下了。漂亮。

column1: See, Rosie gets it!
column2: 瞧，Rosie 懂这个！

column1: Shit.
column2: 操。

column1: Smells like liquor. Someone brewing in the back maybe.
column2: 有股酒味。也许有人在后面酿。

column1: Sounds like a fun camp.
column2: 听着是个快活的营地。

column1: Stop wasting time on such irrelevant observations.
column2: 别把时间浪费在这些不相干的观察上。

column1: Sure was.
column2: 可不是。

column1: Sure, look at that spot right there. That's clearly an ass-print.
column2: 当然，看那儿。那分明是个屁股印。

column1: That's disgusting, Peregrine.
column2: 真恶心，Peregrine。

column1: The crusader can't take a dirty joke? Colour me surprised!
column2: 十字军听不得下流笑话？我可真是吃惊！

column1: The skulduggery is delightful. Very romantic.
column2: 这种鬼祟真是讨人喜欢。非常浪漫。

column1: This tunnel was added recently. Probably not for that, though.
column2: 这条地道是最近才挖的。不过大概不是为了那个。

column1: Through a dirt tunnel though? Why not just rut in the woods?
column2: 可要钻泥地道？为什么不直接在林子里干？

column1: Vank, you're an asshole.
column2: Vank，你真是个混蛋。

column1: We used these kinds of tunnels to ferret people back and forth to keep them away from town guards.
column2: 我们用这种地道把人来回偷运，躲开镇上的卫兵。

column1: Well you know me. I'm all about being consistent.
column2: 你了解我。我这人最讲究一贯。

column1: What, do goblins just screw in the street?
column2: 什么，哥布林直接在街上干？

column1: What? I'm not! You should have a few drinks before you screw.
column2: 什么？我才没有！干之前该先喝上几杯。

column1: Whoah, seriously?
column2: 哇，真的假的？

column1: Yep. In piles usually.
column2: 对。通常叠成一堆。

column1: Yes, an escape route to a warm body and a secret rut in the dark!
column2: 对，一条通往热身子的逃路，好在黑暗里偷偷干一炮！

column1: You can still do it in the dirt tunnel while you're in the woods.
column2: 人在林子里，照样可以钻进泥地道里干。

column1: You offering?
column2: 你要上吗？

column1: You think they'd spend that much time digging a tunnel for that? It seems like maybe an escape route or something.
column2: 你觉得他们会花那么长时间挖地道，就为了那个？看着倒像是逃生通道什么的。

column1: You're such a child, Peregrine. Stay focused.
column2: 你真是个孩子，Peregrine。专心。

column1: You're very imaginative, Peregrine.
column2: 你想象力真丰富，Peregrine。

column1: Zan, for a guy who spends as much time with his ass out as you do, you have a very poor sense of humour. Aren't demons supposed to be all about forbidden fun-having?
column2: Zan，以你光着屁股的时间来说，你的幽默感可真差。恶魔不该就是专门干那些禁忌的快活事吗？

column1: He wanted children.
column2: 他想要孩子。

column1: He was always free to do anything he wanted, and I was locked down! Why is that so hard to understand?!
column2: 他始终自由自在，我却被按得死死的！这有什么难懂的？！

column1: I always thought he was on my side. I thought he understood, thought he supported me. How could he play along with such an unfair law?
column2: 我一直以为他站在我这边。我以为他懂，以为他支持我。他怎么能顺着这么不公的法律走？

column1: I don't really care which. It's your life, after all.
column2: 我其实不在乎是哪一种。毕竟是你的人生。

column1: I doubt anybody else here was on trial for trying to serve their country.
column2: 我不信这儿还有谁是因为想为国效力才受审的。

column1: I gather that is the case for most of us.
column2: 我想我们大多数人确实不是。

column1: I know all about Tsarathi law, Rangda. Those laws are there to keep your people alive and to keep you safe, but you could've run to the frontiers at any time and lived as free as you pleased.
column2: 察拉思的法律我清楚得很，Rangda。那些法律是为了让你们族人活下去，也是为了保你平安，可你随时都能逃去边疆，爱怎么自由就怎么过。

column1: I see. You knew this and broke the law anyway?
column2: 原来如此。你知道，还是破了法？

column1: I thought after we escaped, we could go somewhere on the frontiers, like you said, and that we'd just... live. Have a few sons. Be a family away from all the laws and pressure.
column2: 我以为逃出来以后，我们可以去边疆某个地方，就像你说的，然后就……过日子。生几个儿子。远离那些法律和压力，做一家人。

column1: If he was just a tool to achieve your goal, that's one thing, but you can't use him as a tool while crying over the fact that he doesn't love you. He is as right to seek his path as you are to seek yours.
column2: 如果他只是你达成目的的工具，那是一回事，可你不能一边把他当工具，一边又哭他不爱你。他有权走自己的路，正如你有权走你的。

column1: It's better than camping out in the cold. It'll be fine.
column2: 总比在冷风里露营强。不会有事。

column1: Just because it's not easy doesn't mean you can't do it, Rangda. Isn't that the whole point?
column2: 不容易，不等于你做不到，Rangda。这不就是关键吗？

column1: Mind your tongue, human!
column2: 留意你的舌头，人类！

column1: Nazar sat there beside me looking like he was going to cry. I cried. More out of rage than anything else, you understand.
column2: Nazar 坐在我旁边，看着像要哭出来。我哭了。你明白，更多是气的，不是别的。

column1: No, of course not. You're right to want to be free of that, if that is what you wanted.
column2: 不，当然不是。你想摆脱那个，如果那就是你想要的，那你没错。

column1: No. I don't have good memories of courthouses.
column2: 不。我对法庭没什么好记忆。

column1: Not exactly cozy, is it?
column2: 不算安逸，对吧？

column1: Oh, please. Are you going to give me another lecture about how I should have sat in that gilded cage and played nice? I've heard it all before, so save your breath.
column2: 哦，得了。你是不是又要教训我，说我本该坐在那只镀金笼子里乖乖听话？这些我全听过了，省省吧。

column1: Perhaps you'd best mind my tongue instead.
column2: 也许你最好留意我的舌头。

column1: Rangda. I didn't think anyone else was awake. Can't sleep?
column2: Rangda。我没想到还有人醒着。睡不着？

column1: So, change what you want.
column2: 那就去改你想改的。

column1: That doesn't matter anymore though. I guess neither of us got what we wanted.
column2: 不过那已经无所谓了。我想我们谁都没得到想要的。

column1: That was the day I lost him, the day I started planning this. And now...
column2: 那一天我失去了他，也从那一天起我开始筹划这些。而现在……

column1: The reason I took so long to come after him was because it took me that long to decide that I wanted to give him that.
column2: 我过了那么久才来找他，是因为我花了那么久，才决定我想把那个给他。

column1: Tsarathi law forbids women from serving in the military, even when they are capable. It also punishes a woman's husband if she breaks this law. It's hideously unfair.
column2: 察拉思的法律禁止女人从军，哪怕她们做得到。女人破了这条法，连她的丈夫也要受罚。不公得可恶。

column1: Ugh, did I really need to know that?
column2: 呃，我真有必要知道这个吗？

column1: Well, everyone make yourselves at home then. I'm gonna go find a place to till some soil.
column2: 那大家都随便安顿吧。我去找个地方翻翻土。

column1: What did he want?
column2: 他想要什么？

column1: What did your husband want? Do you know? Do you even care?
column2: 你丈夫想要什么？你知道吗？你在乎过吗？

column1: What law is that?
column2: 哪条法律？

column1: You are absolutely right to hate that cage you were in, but you are absolutely wrong if you think you know even the first thing about the world outside of it. The cage was a forced kindness, and freedom is limitless and cruel. Embrace it, or drag your cage behind you forever.
column2: 你恨自己待过的那只笼子，完全没错，可你要是以为自己对笼子外面的世界哪怕懂一点皮毛，那就大错特错。那笼子是强加的善意，自由则无边，而且残酷。拥抱它，不然就永远把笼子拖在身后。

column1: You chatter on over your spoiled passion play like a bored noblewoman, because that's exactly what you are.
column2: 你把那出被宠坏的受难剧絮叨个没完，活像个闲出病的贵妇，因为你就是这种人。

column1: You say that like it's the easiest thing to do.
column2: 你说得倒轻巧。

column1: ...bridge to the pocket realm I have purchased. If I have been careful enough, no traces will remain, and it will be impossible for anyone to follow, or to undo my work. The town will simply cease to be, and the island will be better for it. -K
column2: ……通往我购得的口袋界域的桥。我若足够小心，便不会留下痕迹，任何人都无法追随，也无法撤销我做下的事。这座镇子将就此不复存在，这座岛会因此更好。——K

column1: Aha, our jailor reveals herself! How many years now have I hunted you? How many deaths do I owe you for locking me away?
column2: 啊哈，我们的狱卒现形了！我猎了你多少年？你把我锁在这里，我该让你死多少回才够？

column1: And now, you are commanded to die!
column2: 现在，我命令你死！

column1: Anyone caught using the mayor's private lounge area will be severely punished.
column2: 凡被撞见使用市长私人休息处者，将受严惩。

column1: I tried for so long to find a way to save these people from their mayor, but I am done trying. Their willful ignorance and refusal to help themselves turns my stomach, and the world will be no sorer for their loss. My patience is spent, and tonight they will all die.
column2: 我试了那么久，想把这些人从他们的市长手里救出来，可我不再试了。他们执意无知，不肯自救，令我作呕。这世界也不会为失去他们多痛一分。我的耐心已经耗尽，今晚他们全都得死。

column1: Men! It is time to collect our dues!
column2: 弟兄们！该收我们的账了！

column1: Now, there remains only one.
column2: 现在，只剩下一个。

column1: Oh, I'm not going anywhere, and neither are you. While you were busy with these fools, I was busy severing the last threads that connect this place with the other side.
column2: 哦，我哪儿也不去，你也别想走。你们忙着对付这些蠢货的时候，我在切断这地方与另一边之间最后的丝线。

column1: Thanks to your interference, my snare was nearly slipped. Take your fool adventuring elsewhere, and never return. All here are slain.
column2: 多亏你们多管闲事，我的圈套差点被挣脱。把你们愚蠢的冒险滚到别处去，永远别再回来。这里的人全死了。

column1: The drums have been ensorcelled and are ready for use. Once they've been lit, this well should suffice as a...
column2: 鼓已施法完毕，可以使用。一旦点燃，这口井应当足以当作……

column1: This is my realm, and it obeys my whim! You can't defeat me here! Even death kneels when I command it!
column2: 这是我的界域，它顺从我的心意！你们在这里击败不了我！即便是死亡，也会在我号令时跪倒！

column1: Visitors, opening the door from the outside. I wanted to thank you, but I have watched you maim and slaughter my people. Did you think that you would be allowed your trespasses without consequence?
column2: 外来者，从外面打开了门。我本想向你们道谢，可我看着你们残害、屠戮我的人民。你们以为擅闯可以毫无后果？

column1: We'll count them together, slowly, just as soon as I finish dealing with these intruders. Do stay put.
column2: 我们会一起，慢慢地数。等我先解决这些闯入者。老实待着。

column1: You really don't understand, do you?
column2: 你真是一点都不明白，对吗？

column1: You shall pay for your intrusion with your blood and your bones, and I shall from your flesh forge a gateway back into the real world!
column2: 你们要用血和骨为这次闯入偿付，而我要用你们的血肉，锻出一扇回到现实世界的大门！

column1: Again? This isn't good. You guys go back to Hayill and tell the alpha about this.
column2: 又来？这可不妙。你们回海伊尔，把这事告诉头狼。

column1: Grant! It was the leeches again. The people were already dead when we arrived, and we caught them doctoring the place up to make it look like it was us.
column2: Grant！又是那些水蛭。我们赶到的时候人已经死了，还抓住他们在布置现场，想弄得像是我们干的。

column1: I'd like to clean this up, but if we try to hide it, it just makes us look guilty. Leave them to the scavengers of the woods, I say. There's nothing to be done for it now.
column2: 我是想收拾一下，可要是藏起来，反倒显得我们有罪。我说，留给林子里吃腐肉的东西吧。现在已经没办法了。

column1: Right. He ain't gonna be happy...
column2: 行。他可不会高兴……

column1: Ritter! What happened?
column2: Ritter！出什么事了？

column1: Still, I guess it's good that you saw this. Now you know just what kind of awful shit Frico has been doing.
column2: 不过，你看见了也好。现在你知道 Frico 一直在干多么恶心的狗屁事了。

column1: They've been doing this a lot lately. Frico's vampires spot a trading caravan heading for Hayill, and they slaughter them.
column2: 他们最近老干这个。Frico 的吸血鬼一发现有商队往海伊尔去，就把人杀光。

column1: What's more, they mangle the bodies and leave them in places where others can find them, to make it look like we're the ones doing it. It makes me fucking sick.
column2: 而且他们把尸体糟蹋得不像样，丢在别人找得到的地方，好让人以为是我们干的。我他妈恶心透了。

column1: -that is, one of my cousins was the duchess there. It's a scenic place, but the only thing there of any note is the graveyard, where King Chevre is buried.
column2: ——就是说，我的一位表亲曾经是那儿的女公爵。那地方风景不错，可唯一值得一提的是墓地，Chevre 国王就葬在那里。

column1: Groundskeeper\n\nCall if you need assistance, but pray be patient if the hour is late.
column2: 园丁\n\n若需协助，请呼唤，但若时辰已晚，还请耐心。

column1: I still have my key. Max always told me to come by whenever I wanted. He made me feel at home here.
column2: 我的钥匙还在。Max 总说我想什么时候来都行。他让我觉得这里像家。

column1: I take it you know this place?
column2: 看来你认识这里？

column1: I wouldn't dare try to cross the strait by boat for fear of Leviathan, but I think that one of the royal transit lines connects. Perhaps the tunnel is still useable.
column2: 我不敢坐船渡海峡，怕 Leviathan，不过我想有一条皇家渡运线是通的。也许隧道还用得上。

column1: It's Maxim's hunting lodge. Or, I suppose, it was.
column2: 这是 Maxim 的狩猎小屋。或者说，曾经是。

column1: Max. How could you really be gone?
column2: Max。你怎么会真的不在了？

column1: Mother, mother, remember me.
column2: 母亲，母亲，记住我。

column1: The Babe almost surely means the Isle of Babe, off the western shore. One of my cousins is-
column2: The Babe 几乎可以肯定是指西岸外的 Babe 岛。我有一位表亲就——

column1: These premises are property of Lord Maxim Spartill. If you are in desperate need of shelter, please alert the groundskeeper. Someone will take care of you.
column2: 此地乃领主 Maxim Spartill 的产业。你若急需栖身，请告知园丁。会有人照料你。

column1: Well, maybe this is the only vestige of home left for me. Just promise me that you'll be respectful, alright?
column2: 好吧，也许这是家留给我的最后一点痕迹。答应我，你们会尊重这里，好吗？

column1: Yes, I know it very well. I spent many nights here, laughing and bragging and drinking.
column2: 是，我熟悉得很。许多个夜里我都在这里，笑、吹牛、喝酒。

column1: chasing the babe
column2: 追逐 Babe

column1: ...my last work... take it... live... and love...where I...cannot...
column2: ……我最后的作品……拿去……活着……并且爱……在我……不能……

column1: ...thank... you..
A stone... born of suffering... to plant a seed... of love... this... you seek
column2: 一块石头……生于苦难……用来种下……爱的种子……这……你所寻的

column1: I cannot see... your face... but your pain... sings to me... your intentions... give to me... the stone...
column2: 我看不见……你的脸……可你的痛苦……在对我唱……你的心意……交给我……那块石头……

column1: I hear... echoes. Your pain... the song of the hammer... on steel...
column2: 我听见……回声。你的痛苦……锤子的歌……敲在钢上……

column1: I've need of a smith. Will you help me?
column2: 我需要一位铁匠。你愿意帮我吗？

column1: Mercy... nary a mercy... nary a mercy...
column2: 慈悲……没有慈悲……没有慈悲……

column1: Take it... my greatest work... yours...
column2: 拿去……我最伟大的作品……是你的了……

column1: Thank you friend. Rest well.
column2: 谢谢你，朋友。好好安息。

column1: The one...who seeks... must... come alone...
column2: 寻求者……必须……独自前来……

column1: You... have awakened... the crystal.  You... are the one... my grave... beneath...
column2: 你……唤醒了……水晶。你……就是那个人……我的墓……在下面……

column1: Your pain... is forged... your life... through my hammer...
column2: 你的痛苦……已锻成……你的生命……经由我的锤……

column1: Ah well. I'm sure they got everything that was worth taking. Guess it's time to wander on.
column2: 唉，算了。值钱的他们肯定都拿走了。大概该接着走了。

column1: I don't suppose you could get me out of here?
column2: 不知你能不能把我从这儿弄出去？

column1: I was raiding the place for goodies when I got surprised by a band of rogues. I hid down here in the cellar, but the place is not in the best shape, you see, and the ceiling caved in. I'm stuck back here good and proper.
column2: 我正翻这地方找好东西，冷不丁撞上一伙无赖。我躲到这地窖里，可你也看见了，这地方不大结实，天花板塌了。我被结结实实困在后面了。

column1: I'm Greening. This place seemed like it might have some food or supplies, so I started poking around. Those thugs either followed me, or I have rotten luck and we just picked the same target.
column2: 我是 Greening。这地方看着也许有吃的或补给，我就到处翻了翻。那些暴徒要么跟着我来，要么就是我倒霉透顶，跟他们看上了同一个目标。

column1: Oh bollocks. It's all over now, isn't it?
column2: 哦，妈的。这下全完了，是不是？

column1: Oh my!
column2: 哎呀！

column1: Oh! You aren't one of those ruffians, are you?
column2: 哦！你不是那些流氓吧？

column1: Stewpot Roadstop\n\nBeef served every day! Come on in!
column2: 炖锅休息站\n\n每天供应牛肉！进来吧！

column1: That doesn't sound good.
column2: 听着不妙。

column1: Well that was close. Cheers for the rescue, eh?
column2: 好险。谢你救命，啊？

column1: Ah, Dame Borgnina. Are you leaving so soon?
column2: 啊，Borgnina 女爵士。这么快就要走了？

column1: And I knew this, somewhere in the back of my mind, but I was still willing to force an agonizing baptism in holy flame just in case.
column2: 我在心底某处知道这一点，可我还是愿意逼他们接受一场圣火中的痛苦洗礼，以防万一。

column1: As for me... it seems my pilgrimage is far from over. I'll be leaving soon, but thanks to you, these sisters will never know the agony I nearly subjected them to. The suffering that would have been on my hands. Thank you.
column2: 至于我……这场朝圣似乎远没有结束。我很快就走，可多亏了你，这些修女永远不会知道我差点加在她们身上的痛苦。那份苦难本会沾在我的手上。谢谢你。

column1: Rangda seethes silently for a long moment, torn somewhere between screaming and crying, though she does neither.
column2: Rangda 沉默地憋了好一阵，像是在尖叫和哭出来之间撕扯，但她哪样都没做。

column1: Finally, she looks up at you, her face clouded with rage.
column2: 终于，她抬起头看着你，脸上满是怒气。

column1: A massive bearded orc dressed in tattered leather strides out from the underbrush. He must be the one who has been camping here.
column2: 一个留着大胡子、穿着破旧皮甲的壮硕兽人从灌木丛里大步走出来。在这儿扎营的应该就是他。

column1: An orc woman in well-made riveted leather armour emerges from the underbrush. She must be the one who has been camping here.
column2: 一个穿着做工精良的铆钉皮甲的兽人女子从灌木丛里走出来。在这儿扎营的应该就是她。

column1: But... the ritual is necessary. Surely, they can't just...
column2: 可是……仪式是必要的。她们总不能就这么……

column1: Everyone deserves hope and comfort, even the forsaken souls of this island. That is why we came here, as missionaries to bring hope to those who have none.
column2: 每个人都该得到希望和安慰，哪怕是这座岛上被遗弃的灵魂。正因如此，我们才来到这里，作为传教士，把希望带给那些没有希望的人。

column1: Excellent. I am Dame Constance Borgnina, a crusader in the service of the Holy Lord, and I have come to this island of my own volition, as a sort of pilgrimage.
column2: 很好。我是 Constance Borgnina 女爵士，侍奉圣主的十字军。我自愿来到这座岛，权当一场朝圣。

column1: Forget the ritual, then. They've managed for years, and they'll continue to manage without me.
column2: 那就把仪式忘了吧。她们这些年都应付过来了，没有我也会继续应付下去。

column1: Go quickly, and try not to rouse suspicion. I don't know how long I can keep the sisters confined to this room.
column2: 快走，尽量别引起怀疑。我不知道还能把修女们关在这间屋里多久。

column1: Have you reconsidered? Will you help me to save the sisters?
column2: 你重新考虑过了吗？你愿意帮我拯救这些修女吗？

column1: I felt the energy shift when you placed the last jewel. Good work. Now, all that remains is for me to make the final incantations.
column2: 你放上最后一颗宝石时，我感到那股能量变了。干得好。现在，只剩下我来念最后的咒语。

column1: I have come to this parish only recently, and what I have seen here disturbs me. The sisters, like me, have come here in pilgrimage, long ago, but in their time spent here, something is... changing them.
column2: 我来到这个堂区还不久，在这里的所见却令我不安。这些修女和我一样，很久以前是来朝圣的，可她们待在这里的日子里，有什么东西……正在改变她们。

column1: I have prepared a ritual that can purge the corruption from the sisters, and from the abbey, but if I enact it on my own, it will alert them to my suspicion, and they may try to disrupt it or to flee. Instead, I will have you perform the preparations, while I make sure the sisters remain within this room.
column2: 我准备了一场仪式，能净化修女们身上的腐化，也能净化这座修道院。可要是我独自施行，就会让她们察觉我的怀疑，她们可能会试图搅乱仪式，或者逃走。所以，准备的事交给你来做，我来确保修女们留在这间屋里。

column1: I see. Perhaps once you've rested and had a look around, you will hear what I have to say. Come and find me later.
column2: 明白了。也许等你休息过、四处看过，就会愿意听我说。过后再来找我。

column1: I will wait until you are clear before I begin. Thank you again.
column2: 我会等你走远了再开始。再次谢谢你。

column1: If you have other matters to attend to, I understand, but without your help I may need to resort to more drastic measures. Please come and find me if you change your mind.
column2: 你若另有要事，我能理解，可没有你的帮助，我也许只能采取更激烈的手段。你若改变主意，请来找我。

column1: It is an interesting time for this island. The prisons can't possibly contain everybody, and something is sure to rise out of all of the chaos. We will try to guide the lost through the confusion the best we can.
column2: 这座岛正处在一个有意思的时期。监狱根本关不住所有人，这一片混乱里肯定会冒出什么来。我们会尽力引导那些迷失的人走过这迷茫。

column1: It isn't right, is it? I wanted... needed there to be demons, needed some kind of evil that I could fight, but... they're just human beings cut off from the rest of the world. Human beings with human vices.
column2: 这不对，是不是？我想要……我需要有恶魔存在，需要某种我能够与之战斗的邪恶，可是……他们只是与其余世界隔绝的人。是有着凡人恶习的人。

column1: My gut is telling me that something is wrong here. There is something lending a corrupting influence, and I owe it to my sisters to find it and stop it. In this, I need your help.
column2: 我的直觉告诉我，这里有问题。有什么东西正在施加腐化的影响。为了我的修女姐妹，我必须找到它、制止它。这件事，我需要你的帮助。

column1: Please go. You haven't sworn the oaths to this order, so there is no need for you to suffer the purge.
column2: 请走吧。你并未向这个修会宣誓，不必承受这场净化。

column1: Sisters! In the name of God, we shall purge this evil from our world! Come!
column2: 修女们！以上帝之名，我们要把这邪恶从我们的世界净化出去！来！

column1: Strangers? Mayhap my prayers have been answered. Thank God. May we talk?
column2: 陌生人？也许我的祷告得到了回应。感谢上帝。我们可以谈谈吗？

column1: Take these, and position them outside the corners of the abbey, or as close to the corners as you can manage. Once they are in place, I can complete the ritual, and all corruption within the abbey will be purged. The sisters will be saved.
column2: 把这些拿去，放在修道院外侧的四角，或者尽量靠近四角的地方。一旦放好，我就能完成仪式，修道院里的一切腐化都会被净化。修女们会得救。

column1: Their behaviors are strange and lax, rituals are forgotten or distorted, and they've given in to petty vanities that are beneath a sister of the order.
column2: 她们的行为古怪而散漫，仪式被遗忘或被歪曲，她们还屈从于那些有失修会修女身份的琐碎虚荣。

column1: There... is nothing of note here, and I would prefer not to linger. Do what you must, and then let us move on.
column2: 这里……没什么值得留意的，我也不想久留。你做你必须做的，然后我们继续走。

column1: We don't get word from the mainland way out here. Have you any word of how things are in Crest?
column2: 我们在这么远的地方，收不到大陆的消息。你可有克雷斯特那边的音讯？

column1: We don't have much to offer you, but any of us would be glad to lend an ear for your troubles.
column2: 我们能给你的不多，但我们谁都乐意倾听你的烦恼。

column1: We hadn't had visitors for a very long time, and then we have both Dame Borgnina and you within a few days. It's a busy time, I suppose.
column2: 我们很久没有客人了，结果几天之内，Borgnina 女爵士和你们都来了。算是一段忙时候吧，我想。

column1: Welcome to the abbey, dear. If you are weary, our doors are open to you. Come and rest.
column2: 欢迎来到修道院，亲爱的。你若疲倦，我们的门为你敞开。来休息吧。

column1: What have I become?
column2: 我究竟变成了什么？

column1: Will you help me stop the corruption that is preying upon my sisters?
column2: 你愿意帮我阻止那腐化继续蚕食我的修女姐妹吗？

column1: Yes. There is... much to be done. I mustn't linger. Farewell, sister.
column2: 是的。还有……许多事要做。我不能久留。再会，修女。

column1: You had best leave now. The purging will be... painful, and you should not be subject to it.
column2: 你最好现在就离开。净化会……很痛，你不该去承受它。

column1: You've returned. Will you hear what I have to say?
column2: 你回来了。愿意听我说吗？

column1: You, Maledicus, would dare to set foot in a house of God? I am his agent, and I shall be your shepherd! Meet him for true and be judged!
column2: 你，咒师，竟敢踏进上帝的殿？我是他的使者，我来做你的牧者！去真正面见他，接受审判！

column1: ...Paul...
column2: ……Paul……

column1: Alright. Those injuries are bad, but that should help him make it back to the stronghold.
column2: 好了。伤得很重，不过这样应该能让他撑回据点。

column1: Bato!
column2: Bato！

column1: Bato! Paul! Are you alright?!
column2: Bato！Paul！你们没事吧？！

column1: Bato!!
column2: Bato！！

column1: Come on buddy, wait for me!
column2: 加油，伙计，等我！

column1: Get your greasy claws off of me you stinking buzzards!
column2: 把你们油腻的爪子从我身上拿开，你们这些臭秃鹫！

column1: He's hurt bad, but he's alive! Looks like he managed to hang on to that harpy for most of the drop.
column2: 他伤得很重，可他还活着！看起来坠落的大半段路，他都抓着那只哈比。

column1: How are you feeling, Paul? You don't look so good.
column2: 你感觉怎么样，Paul？你看上去不太好。

column1: I'm fine. I'll have time to hurt after he's tucked into a healer's tent.
column2: 我没事。等把他安顿进治疗师的帐篷，有的是时间再疼。

column1: If you hadn't jumped, we'd have lost Bato for sure. It was stupid, but you saved his life. I'm sure he'll thank you when he's awake.
column2: 你要是没跳，我们肯定就失去 Bato 了。很蠢，可你救了他的命。等他醒过来，一定会谢你。

column1: It's weird, isn't it? You can sort of feel it. The urge to just throw yourself off. If a man was already losing himself in sorrow, I can imagine how it might pull you over.
column2: 很怪，对吧？你能隐约感觉到。那种想直接跳下去的冲动。要是一个人本来就沉在悲伤里，我能想象它会怎么把你拽下去。

column1: Look at all the grave markers. This place gives me the creeps.
column2: 看看这些墓碑。这地方让我发毛。

column1: Ngh! Hang on, Bato!
column2: 呃！撑住，Bato！

column1: Shit! Harpies!
column2: 操！哈比！

column1: Shit, Paul! What are you doing?!
column2: 操，Paul！你在干什么？！

column1: That's not happening boss, sorry.
column2: 这可不行，首领，抱歉。

column1: We don't have to stay long. Let's just see if we can spot anything along the coastline, and then get out.
column2: 我们不必久留。看看能不能沿海岸发现点什么，然后就走。

column1: We'll get some rope! Just stay there and don't move!
column2: 我们去拿绳子！你待在那儿，别动！

column1: We're too far out to even get a decent view of anything. I think this plan was a wash.
column2: 我们离得太远，什么都看不真切。我觉得这计划泡汤了。

column1: You better not leave me, Bato. You better not!
column2: 你可别扔下我，Bato。你可别！

column1: You should let someone else carry him. Give your body some rest.
column2: 你该让别人来抬他。让你的身子歇一歇。

column1: -but you aren't alone. You don't have to fight alone, you don't have to mourn alone, and you don't have to suffer alone.
column2: ——可你并不孤单。你不必独自战斗，不必独自哀悼，也不必独自受苦。

column1: ...have any good reason to refuse. Lead the way.
column2: ……有什么好理由拒绝。带路吧。

column1: All clear. It's no luxury, but it's dry at least.
column2: 安全。算不上奢侈，至少是干的。

column1: An accidental touch. A look that's a little too long, a smile that's a little too warm. You shared those things, I know you did.
column2: 一次无意的触碰。一个略长了一点的注视，一个略暖了一点的微笑。这些你都跟他有过，我知道你有过。

column1: And I would spend my nights staring at the ceiling, or watching his breath pass his lips, wishing that I could ...
column2: 而我会整夜盯着天花板，或者看着他的呼吸掠过嘴唇，盼着我能够……

column1: Are you out there, Max?
column2: 你在外面吗，Max？

column1: As I'm sure you might imagine.
column2: 正如你想必想象得到的。

column1: As it turns out, I wasn't even a worthy sacrifice. I prevented nothing, and I have nothing.
column2: 结果呢，我甚至算不上一份配得上的祭品。我什么也没能阻止，我也一无所有。

column1: Aye, and I don't fancy trailing through the darkness holding hands, either. We should turn back.
column2: 是啊，我也不想在黑暗里手拉手摸索过去。我们该回去。

column1: Certainly, just let me fetch my clothes.
column2: 当然，让我先去把衣服取来。

column1: Do you really think he didn't know? You wear your heart so far down your sleeve, I'm surprised it doesn't fall into your breakfast.
column2: 你真以为他不知道？你的心都挂到袖子外头了，我奇怪它怎么还没掉进你的早饭里。

column1: Drag me off and tear me to ribbons if it pleases you. I no longer care.
column2: 你想把我拖走、撕成碎片，就请便。我已经不在乎了。

column1: Hah. Damn you for making so much sense, Brunok.
column2: 哈。真该死，Brunok，你说得太有道理了。

column1: He knew full well that you loved him. How could he not? He kept you as close as he did because he loved you just the same, and he never said anything for the same damned reasons you just told me.
column2: 他完全知道你爱他。他怎么会不知道？他把你留得那么近，正因为他也同样爱你；而他始终不说，理由跟你刚才告诉我的那些该死的理由一模一样。

column1: He was my cousin's husband! I would never-!
column2: 他是我表亲的丈夫！我绝不会——！

column1: I am right here. Talk to me.
column2: 我就在这儿。跟我说话。

column1: I can find my way by scent, but I guess that doesn't help you guys.
column2: 我能靠气味找路，不过我猜这帮不上你们。

column1: I didn't walk into that prison willingly for my cousin, I did it for him, so that the people would have their blood, and his would be spared.
column2: 我不是为了表亲才自愿走进那座监狱，我是为了他，好让那些人得到他们要的血，而他的血得以保全。

column1: I do.
column2: 喜欢。

column1: I don't really think I...
column2: 我其实并不觉得我……

column1: I get a lot of requests for that lately.
column2: 最近这种请求我接到不少。

column1: I had a feeling. Shall we, then?
column2: 我就有这种感觉。那么，走吧？

column1: I suppose we all look the same to you?
column2: 我猜在你看来，我们都长一个样？

column1: I understand you loved him, Luc. I can hear your heart breaking every time we walk past one of those damned statues.
column2: 我知道你爱他，Luc。每次我们走过那些该死的雕像，我都听得见你的心在碎。

column1: I was supposed to die fat and full of ale, not waging war in the ruins of my homeland.
column2: 我本该死的时候肥肥胖胖、灌一肚子麦酒，而不是在故乡的废墟里打仗。

column1: I'm so lost, Max. I don't know what to do. I wish you were here.
column2: 我太迷茫了，Max。我不知道该怎么办。真希望你在这儿。

column1: Id varum! It's dark, how was I supposed to know it was you!?
column2: Id varum！这么黑，我怎么知道是你！？

column1: If his memory is so precious, you need to stop dragging it around and wear it proudly. It's what he would want, isn't it?
column2: 要是对他的记忆这么珍贵，你就别再拖着它走，把它骄傲地戴上。这才是他想要的，不是吗？

column1: Irum noct! Id Jamd'katch!
column2: Irum noct！Id Jamd'katch！

column1: It would have been a betrayal of my country, my queen, and our friendship, and so I never spoke my heart.
column2: 那会背叛我的国家、我的女王，还有我们的友谊，所以我从未把心里话说出口。

column1: It's a warm night and the rest of us are already naked. You'll make us feel awkward. Come on, it can be a new experience.
column2: 今晚很暖和，我们其余的人都已经光着了。你这样会让我们不自在。来吧，就当是一次新体验。

column1: It's okay guys, he's with me. You can go back, I'll catch up.
column2: 没事，伙计们，他是跟我的。你们回去吧，我随后就到。

column1: Just forget about it.
column2: 忘了吧。

column1: Luc, I'm sorry. The world moved on while you stood still and I know that you feel lost and confused and alone-
column2: Luc，对不起。你停在原地，世界却已经往前走了。我知道你觉得迷失、困惑、孤单——

column1: Luc, what are you doing out here?
column2: Luc，你跑到这儿来做什么？

column1: Luc, you spend so much time talking to ghosts. Try talking to flesh and blood for a change.
column2: Luc，你花那么多时间跟鬼魂说话。换一回，试试跟有血有肉的人说。

column1: Luc, you're an idiot.
column2: Luc，你就是个白痴。

column1: Me and my boys killed a deer. Help us butcher it, and it's venison for breakfast.
column2: 我和弟兄们打了一头鹿。帮我们把肉分解了，早饭就有鹿肉吃。

column1: No?
column2: 不喜欢？

column1: Right this way.
column2: 这边请。

column1: So, you like to hunt, right?
column2: 所以，你喜欢打猎，对吧？

column1: That's an awful thing to say.
column2: 这话太难听了。

column1: That's fine, Grant, we don't need luxury. Not a moment to spare.
column2: 没关系，Grant，我们不需要奢侈。一刻也耽搁不得。

column1: There's a very old hunter's camp nearby, if my memory serves. I can find it, and we probably have enough twilight to make it there without tripping over each other.
column2: 要是我记得不错，附近有一处很古老的猎人营地。我找得到，而且剩下的暮光大概够我们走到，不至于彼此绊倒。

column1: Venison for breakfast is one of my favorite pleasures.
column2: 早饭吃鹿肉，是我最喜欢的享受之一。

column1: Venison for breakfast!
column2: 早饭吃鹿肉！

column1: We don't have a lot of time to figure out an alternative. Lead the way, Grant.
column2: 我们没有多少时间另想办法。带路吧，Grant。

column1: We shouldn't have set out so late. We're going to get lost in this place for sure. Worse than lost if we run into something dangerous.
column2: 我们不该这么晚才出发。在这地方肯定会迷路。要是撞上危险的东西，那比迷路更糟。

column1: We used to go hunting together. Him and I and a few other lads from the capital.
column2: 我们以前常常一起打猎。他和我，还有几个从都城来的小伙子。

column1: We would go out to his lodge and spend days hunting and drinking and laughing.
column2: 我们会去他的猎屋，一连几天打猎、喝酒、大笑。

column1: Well, my country, my queen, and my friend, they're all gone, hundreds of years dust, and I've nothing but a regretful, broken heart that should be rotting alongside them.
column2: 可是，我的国家、我的女王、我的朋友，全都没了，化成几百年的尘土，而我只剩下一颗悔恨的碎心，本该跟着他们一起腐烂。

column1: What's all this about tearing you to ribbons, then?
column2: 那你说把你撕成碎片，又是怎么回事？

column1: Why is it me? This sort of strange journey is the stuff meant for heroes like you.
column2: 为什么是我？这种古怪的旅程，本该是你这样的英雄去走的。

column1: You wouldn't understand.
column2: 你不会懂的。

column1: You're such a straight stick, I actually believe that you would never, but that doesn't mean you never wanted to.
column2: 你正经得像根笔直的棍子，我还真信你绝不会，可那不代表你从来没想过。

column1: You... how do you..?
column2: 你……你怎么会……？

column1: Turn back!
column2: 回去！

column1: You, stranger, honour us with your offering. In return, we shall teach you to hunt as we hunt. Your prey will know no peace.
column2: 你，陌生人，你的供奉令我们荣幸。作为回报，我们将教你如我们一般狩猎。你的猎物将永无宁日。

column1: Bato was nearly eaten by them when we first arrived on the island.
column2: 我们刚到岛上的时候，Bato 差点被它们吃掉。

column1: But you're bigger than they are. Fighting something bigger than you sucks. I'd know.
column2: 可你比它们个头大。跟比自己大的东西打，操蛋得很。我可有体会。

column1: Come on, Bato. We'll be fine.
column2: 来吧，Bato。我们不会有事的。

column1: Could you guys focus please? Treasure now, compensation later.
column2: 你们能不能专心点？先找宝物，补偿以后再说。

column1: I don't, because I'm not a coward!
column2: 我就是不怕，因为我不是懦夫！

column1: I see. Well, don't worry, Bato. Just stand behind me and I'll cut them down.
column2: 明白了。别担心，Bato。站到我身后去，我来把它们砍倒。

column1: I smell them too. Ugh, it's actually really bad now that you mention it.
column2: 我也闻到了。呃，你这么一说，还真是够臭的。

column1: I think I just juiced in my shorts a little. Would you say
column2: 我好像刚在短裤里射出来一点。你能不能把

column1: I'll be right behind you.
column2: 我就跟在你身后。

column1: Is that what that smell is? Huh.
column2: 原来那股味儿是这个？呵。

column1: Let them come. I'll slaughter every last one of them.
column2: 让它们来。我要把它们一个不剩全宰了。

column1: Oh no, no no no! This place smells like sahaguin! They're waiting under the water, I just know it!
column2: 哦不，不，不，不！这地方有沙华鱼人的味儿！它们就等在水下，我就是知道！

column1: Oh, screw you, Harpy! Like you don't have anything you're afraid of!
column2: 哦，去你的，哈比！说得你自己什么都不怕似的！

column1: Okay. Okay, Bato, you can do this. Hands on your weapon, head in the game.
column2: 好。好的，Bato，你行的。手按住武器，心神给我收回来。

column1: Remarkable! It looks like the place swallowed up the wrecks of a dozen ships. Who knows what treasures might be inside?
column2: 了不起！看这样子，这地方把十几艘船的残骸都吞下去了。谁知道里面会有什么宝物？

column1: Shouldn't cowards like you be back at the stronghold washing our clothes? You'll just get in the way, and we're better off without you.
column2: 像你这样的懦夫，不该回据点去给我们洗衣服吗？你只会碍事，没有你我们更好。

column1: Son, if we get a crate of Tsarathi whiskey out of this, I'll go as deep as you want.
column2: 小子，要是能从这儿弄出一箱察拉思威士忌，你想让我进多深，我就进多深。

column1: That's enough, you two!
column2: 你们两个，够了！

column1: We're not going to let anything hurt you, Bato. Relax.
column2: 我们不会让任何东西伤到你，Bato。放松。

column1: Well that is rather unpleasant. After all that work we went through to get this gate open, I hope there's something worthwhile to find.
column2: 这可真够难受的。费了那么大劲才把这扇门打开，希望里面有值得找的东西。

column1: You guys heard him say that, right?
column2: 你们都听见他这么说了，对吧？

column1: You're afraid of sahaguin?
column2: 你怕沙华鱼人？

column1: You're not wrong. There are sahaguin here, and they will find a way to ambush us before we're done with this place.
column2: 你没说错。这儿有沙华鱼人，而且在我们了结这地方之前，它们一定会想办法伏击我们。

column1: a few more times for me, Captain? A little deeper and slower, please.
column2: 再为我多说几遍吗，船长？请再深一点，再慢一点。

column1: A boat? You're as bad as old Logus.
column2: 一艘船？你跟老 Logus 一样没救。

column1: A good day to you travellers. Welcome to The Shipyard.
column2: 旅人们，日安。欢迎来到船厂。

column1: Ah well. Logus had some good stories, but he wasn't much help around town, to be honest. We'll manage without him.
column2: 唉。Logus 的故事是不错，可说实话，他对镇上帮不上什么忙。没有他，我们也能过。

column1: Come to listen to an old sailor flap his tusks? Have a seat, maybe something will come to mind.
column2: 来听一个老水手吧嗒獠牙闲扯？坐下吧，也许能想起什么来。

column1: Everyone except Logus anyway.
column2: 反正 Logus 除外。

column1: Except for those of us doing maintenance, all of the boys are out logging, hunting, and securing the roads right now.
column2: 除了我们这几个做修缮的，小伙子们这会儿都出去伐木、打猎、守路了。

column1: Good day to you, Captain.
column2: 船长，日安。

column1: Good to see you, Captain. Will your friends be needing a place to stay the night?
column2: 见到你真好，船长。你的朋友们今晚要住下吗？

column1: He hasn't come back. I hope he's alright.
column2: 他没有回来。希望他没事。

column1: He's around here somewhere. Maybe you should talk to him about it.
column2: 他就在这附近。也许你该跟他本人谈谈。

column1: I get that he's sentimental for his seafaring days, but that guy has got to learn to let go. We're Lukattites now, like it or not. Gotta make the best of it.
column2: 我知道他舍不得从前航海的日子，可那家伙得学会放手。不管乐不乐意，我们现在是卢卡特人了。得尽量往好处过。

column1: I guess I won't be coming back here for a while. Let me just grab some of my things.
column2: 我猜一时半会儿回不来了。让我拿上几件自己的东西。

column1: I lost my sea legs a long time ago, so don't go asking me about boats and all. I get enough of that nonsense from Logus as it is.
column2: 我早就不是走甲板的人了，所以别来问我船啊什么的。Logus 那些废话我已经听够了。

column1: I see. Well do take care of yourselves.
column2: 这样啊。那你们自己多保重。

column1: I'll go right now and start making preparations. You do anything else you need to do and then come find me, and we'll leave this blasted rock behind for good.
column2: 我现在就去准备。你把其余该办的事办完，再来找我，咱们就永远把这块该死的石头甩在身后。

column1: I'll keep an ear out for supplies in the meantime, but I can't really set anything up until I know we've got a crew. If you're serious about this, then get on it.
column2: 这期间我会留意补给的消息，可在确定有了船员之前，我实在布置不了什么。你要是认真，就去办。

column1: I'll tell you what. You put together a crew, and I'll get the boat. We'll sail anywhere you want to go. We'll leave this cold little rock behind and we'll be free men again. If you've got the guts, of course.
column2: 我跟你说。你去凑齐船员，我去弄船。你想航去哪儿，我们就去哪儿。咱们把这块冰冷的小石头甩开，重新做自由的人。当然，前提是你有那个胆子。

column1: I'm guessing that anybody you find here isn't going to be an experienced sailor, so let's say... twenty. You put together a band of twenty strong backs, and we'll have enough to man the ship.
column2: 我猜你在这儿找着的，都不会是老练水手，所以就定……二十个。你凑一支二十个壮劳力的团伙，就够给这艘船配上人手。

column1: I've found a lot of shipbuilding supplies so far, but that don't do us any good. I wanted to sell them to some travelling merchants, but Logus put up a giant stink and insisted we keep them.
column2: 我到现在找到了不少造船的补给，可那对我们没什么用。我想卖给过路的商人，Logus 却大闹一场，非让我们留着。

column1: I've heard that before. I'll stick to saving us from hunger and exposure, thanks.
column2: 这话我听过。我还是继续管咱们别饿死、别冻死吧，谢了。

column1: If you're looking for curatives, I can mix you up an elixir. For fair coin, of course.\nLet's say 150$
column2: 你要是找疗伤的东西，我可以给你调一剂灵药。当然，价钱公道。\n就按 150$ 算。

column1: Is Logus really gone? I hope I can sell those supplies before he comes back. The extra trade would do us all some good.
column2: Logus 真走了？希望在他回来之前我能把那些补给卖掉。多做点买卖，对大家都有好处。

column1: Is Logus really gone? It seems so quiet now.
column2: Logus 真走了？现在安静得厉害。

column1: Logus just sits and mopes for months on end and then just like that he packs his things and saunters out the gate. He looked pretty happy too.
column2: Logus 能一连几个月坐在那儿闷闷不乐，然后说走就走，收拾东西大摇大摆出了门。看着还挺高兴。

column1: Logus left, looking pleased as can be. You didn't have something to do with that, did you?
column2: Logus 走了，高兴得不行。你该不会跟这事有关吧？

column1: No, but thanks for the offer. We'll be off again shortly.
column2: 不用，不过谢谢你的好意。我们很快又要出发。

column1: Not for long. Just here for some business and then we're off again.
column2: 待不了多久。办点事，然后我们就又走。

column1: Not that I have much faith you'll manage that. I've tried to put together crews before. Always someone putting a knife in someone's back, someone losing their nerve. If you get enough men, come find me, but if not, don't get my hopes up.
column2: 我倒也不怎么信你能办成。我以前试过凑船员。总有人朝别人背上捅刀子，总有人先没了胆子。人凑够了就来找我，凑不够就别勾我的希望。

column1: Oh, Logus, you're back.
column2: 哦，Logus，你回来了。

column1: Perfect. Just give me a minute.
column2: 好极了。稍等我一下。

column1: Right. Well, don't let me keep you then.
column2: 好。那我就不留你了。

column1: Sorry, I have to focus on my work for the shipyard now. Maybe the trader has something that can help you.
column2: 抱歉，我现在得把心思放在船厂的活上。也许商贩那儿有能帮你的东西。

column1: Sorry, but that won't cut it. Can't give my work away for free.
column2: 抱歉，这可不够。我不能把活白送人。

column1: Still working on that crew I see. Look, I ain't gonna be picky. Men or orcs or giants or golems for all I care, makes no difference. I just need twenty people who can take orders.
column2: 我看船员还没凑齐。听着，我不挑。人类、兽人、巨人还是魔像，我都不在乎，都一样。我只要二十个听命令的人。

column1: There are so many crates in these warehouses, we still don't know what's inside all of them.
column2: 这些仓库里箱子太多，里头都装了什么，我们到现在还没弄清。

column1: There you go. I hope it helps.
column2: 给你。希望有用。

column1: There's a place a little distance west of here along the north shore called Forfshire Bay. Used to be a pirates' holdout as I understand.
column2: 从这儿沿北岸往西不远，有个地方叫福夫郡湾。据我所知，从前是海盗的窝点。

column1: There's no need to be that cruel, now is there?
column2: 犯不着那么狠，对吧？

column1: There's still a ship there, a seaworthy one, tucked away in a grotto. I've been out to it several times, so I know it well. I set up a little security you see, so that nobody would be able to find it.
column2: 那儿还停着一艘船，经得起出海的那种，藏在一处洞窟里。我去过好几回，所以熟得很。我设了点防备，免得叫人找着。

column1: These huts might not look very impressive, but they're all we've got. Our boys are gonna be tired when they get home, so I'm making sure that everything stays tight and standing.
column2: 这些棚屋看着不气派，可我们就这点东西。小伙子们回家的时候会累坏，所以我得让这儿样样都严实、立得住。

column1: This place isn't really a shipyard anymore, alright? We live in the old warehouses and all, but we don't build ships or anything. I don't think any of us would even know how.
column2: 这地方其实已经不算船厂了，知道吧？我们住在那些旧仓库里，可不造船，什么都不造。我看我们谁都不会。

column1: Traitor
column2: 叛徒

column1: Trying to save us all. Someone's got to.
column2: 想把咱们都救出去。总得有人干。

column1: Well I'll be damned. I think that just might be enough manpower to pull this off. I didn't want to get my hopes up, but there you went and kicked the stool out from under me.
column2: 真见鬼。我看这人力也许真够把这事办成了。我本来不想抱希望，可你一脚把我脚下的凳子踹掉了。

column1: What are you up to now, Logus?
column2: 你这回又在打什么主意，Logus？

column1: You want to leave this rotten island? There isn't a boat here, but... I do know where there is one.
column2: 你想离开这座烂岛？这儿没有船，不过……我知道哪儿有一艘。

column1: You'd be surprised how busy the boys here keep me. There's always someone with a scrape or a gouge or a pulled hamstring.
column2: 你想不到这儿的小伙子们把我忙成什么样。老有人擦破一层皮、划开一道口，或者拉伤腿筋。

column1: Your loss then. Can't give my work away for free.
column2: 那是你的损失。我不能把活白送人。

column1: , would you? I can't even remember the last time I dug a rut.
column2: ，对吧？我都记不清上次发情干过是什么时候了。

column1: A whore house! I kinda thought it would feel more fun than this. It's really sort of depressing, isn't it?
column2: 窑子！我还以为会比这更带劲。其实挺压抑的，对吧？

column1: Ah, well that is a shame, but if you are not interested, I must ask you to leave. Leave the door open, if you please.
column2: 啊，那真是遗憾。可你若没有兴趣，我只好请你离开。请把门开着。

column1: And I'll thank you kindly. You enjoy yourselves, hear?
column2: 那我就多谢了。你们好好乐，听见没有？

column1: Anyway, I got a bit of lard, and...well, tear my ass up, I guess! Get your money's worth.
column2: 总之我弄了点猪油，然后……好吧，把我屁股干烂吧！钱得花得值。

column1: Are you here to see Ms. Anna? She's wonderful. Really wonderful. I can't wait to see her again.
column2: 你是来见 Anna 女士的吗？她太棒了。真的太棒了。我等不及再见到她。

column1: Are you surprised that this isn't an alehouse? It was once, to be sure, but we've managed to repurpose it. I can't say for a certainty that we're the only brothel on the island, but I don't know of another.
column2: 你惊讶这不是间麦酒馆？从前确实是，不过我们已经把它改作别用。我不敢肯定我们就是这座岛上唯一的妓院，但我不知道还有另一家。

column1: Clear objectives! I can work with that!
column2: 目标明确！这个我能干！

column1: Cute. I can count, idiot. You come back with more coin, or I have Ray and Bo teach you some manners.
column2: 真可爱。我会数数，白痴。带更多的钱回来，不然我让 Ray 和 Bo 教你懂规矩。

column1: Damn, that Mercedes is a screamer. I should've made my appointment with her instead of Anna. Now I feel stupid.
column2: 妈的，那个 Mercedes 叫床叫得真响。我该约她，不该约 Anna。现在我觉得自己真蠢。

column1: Did you indeed? Good information to have.
column2: 是吗？这消息有用。

column1: Do you imagine that it would be worth it?
column2: 你觉得那值得吗？

column1: Do you think there are any humans or orcs who would have sex with a goblin? I wonder what that would be like.
column2: 你觉得会有人类或者兽人愿意跟哥布林做爱吗？我好奇那会是什么样。

column1: Don't go makin' trouble now, hear?
column2: 别惹事，听见没有？

column1: Don't say such awful things. You're beautiful too. Just look at this... and this here. And that too. It's all beautiful. You're beautiful. Why don't you just relax and let me appreciate you?
column2: 别说这么难听的话。你也很美。看看这个……还有这儿。还有那个。全都美。你很美。为什么不放松下来，让我好好欣赏你？

column1: Filthy peasant! A lady of my calibre is worth at least twice that much! Also, fuck you.
column2: 肮脏的乡巴佬！我这种档次的女士至少值两倍！另外，操你妈。

column1: Good to see someone managing to make a business of this place, isn't it? I never did understand why places like this were illegal.
column2: 能看到有人把这儿做成一门生意，挺好，不是吗？我一直不明白，为什么这种地方要算违法。

column1: Guess I'd be a lot richer if I was pretty enough to be a whore.
column2: 要是我长得够漂亮、能当妓女，我大概会有钱得多。

column1: Guess my girl was right about that much.
column2: 看来我那女人至少这点说对了。

column1: Guests in The Breakfast Room will receive room service first thing in the morning. Until then, relax and enjoy your evening!
column2: 早餐房的客人将在清晨最先得到客房服务。在那之前，请放松，享受你们的夜晚！

column1: Hah! What a splendid cover. Do you suppose they have soaps and a bath here? I haven't washed my  hair properly in far too long.
column2: 哈！这层掩护可真漂亮。你觉得他们这儿有肥皂、能洗澡吗？我已经太久没好好洗头了。

column1: Have you had a look around? It's quite a lovely place, isn't it?
column2: 你四处看过了吗？这地方相当可爱，不是吗？

column1: Hello. Have you come to listen to Braisa weave the air into music?
column2: 你好。你是来听 Braisa 把空气编织成音乐的吗？

column1: Hey asshole, get your pet away from me before I put a fist through it.
column2: 嘿，王八蛋，把你的宠物从我面前弄走，不然我一拳打穿它。

column1: Hi again. Can't do you another juicing, sorry. Take on too much side work and I get in trouble. I'm sure you understand.
column2: 又见面了。抱歉，没法再给你榨一回。私活接太多我会有麻烦。我想你明白。

column1: Hmm... they send someone to wake you up in the morning, but... it doesn't say who. I guess I don't really care, but didn't I see an orc man working in the room across the hall?
column2: 嗯……他们早上会派人来叫醒你，可是……没写是谁。我想我也无所谓，不过我是不是看见一个男兽人在走廊对面那间房里干活？

column1: Hmm? I'm fairly certain you aren't my next client. I'm not ready yet anyway. This isn't the sort of thing you can just do nonstop all day long you know.
column2: 嗯？我相当确定你不是我的下一位客人。反正我也还没准备好。这种事可不是能一整天不停地干的，知道吧。

column1: How are things going for you today? Something more exciting than being a bodyguard for trollops, I hope.
column2: 你今天过得怎么样？希望比给一群婊子当保镖更刺激些。

column1: Hoy. You uh... here for a drink?
column2: 嘿。你呃……来喝酒的？

column1: Huh. You're for real? Looks like I'm your man then. Give me a minute to get my stuff. Oh, and call me Leftie. Left-handed and also because... well that part doesn't matter. See you when you're ready to go.
column2: 呵。你来真的？那看来你要的人就是我了。给我一分钟拿东西。哦，叫我 Leftie。左撇子，还有因为……嗯，那部分不重要。你准备走了再来见我。

column1: I ain't leaving for less than 1000$. They might pay me shit, but at least I get to sleep indoors.
column2: 少于1000$我可不走。他们给的钱是狗屎，可至少我能睡在屋里。

column1: I am sorry, but I am told that I now have appointments waiting. I must ask you to leave so I will have time to prepare.
column2: 抱歉，不过有人告诉我，现在有预约在等着。我得请你离开，好让我有时间准备。

column1: I can give you a quick squeeze, if that's what you're looking for. Madame doesn't need to know about it, do she? It ain't full service, but you get to cut the line, and it'll only cost you 50$. Just shut the door and lay down.
column2: 你要是想要这个，我可以给你快速挤一下。鸨母不必知道，对吧？不算全套，可你能插队，只要50$。把门关上，躺下就行。

column1: I can hardly stand waiting anymore. If I don't get in soon, I'm going to break down and just drag one of these guys over to that empty room.
column2: 我简直等不下去了。要是不能马上进去，我就要绷不住，直接把这些人里的一个拖去那间空房。

column1: I complain about it, but this place here is about as safe as it gets on this island. As safe, and boring as it gets. Also, have you noticed how much this place smells like cocks? I think it's the Ettins.
column2: 我是抱怨，可这地方在这岛上已经算最安全的了。安全到了头，也无聊到了头。还有，你注意到这地方的鸡巴味有多重吗？我觉得是那些双头巨人。

column1: I don't think I would classify those looks I am getting as
column2: 我不觉得我会把现在这些看我的眼神归为

column1: I heard about this place, but never actually been myself. I doubt they got anyone who can handle my timber though. Too bad.
column2: 我听说过这地方，可自己从没来过。不过我怀疑他们没人扛得住我这根木头。可惜。

column1: I heard that they
column2: 我听说他们

column1: I hope you enjoyed yourself. Recommend me to your friends, hmm?
column2: 希望你尽兴了。把我推荐给你的朋友，嗯？

column1: I never managed to get here before on account of Frico's damn gatekeeping. I wonder if they got any lads who know what to do with rope.
column2: 以前一直没能来，都因为 Frico 那该死的看门。不知道他们有没有懂绳子的小伙子。

column1: I thought this place was an inn, not a brothel. I need a place to sleep though, so... I guess I'm hanging out here for a while.
column2: 我还以为这地方是客栈，不是妓院。不过我需要个地方睡觉，所以……我想我会在这儿耗一阵。

column1: I want to help you out, babe, I do, but I can't do you for free. Come back another time.
column2: 我想帮你，宝贝，真的，可我不能白干你。换个时候再来。

column1: I was hopeful when I saw this place still standing. The spirits they used to brew were some of the best I've ever had.
column2: 看见这地方还立着，我还抱着希望。他们以前酿的那些烈酒，是我喝过最好的一些。

column1: I was hoping to have a meeting with Ms. Zianne, but I think her last client fell asleep on her.
column2: 我本来想跟 Zianne 女士见一面，可我觉得她上一位客人在她身上睡着了。

column1: I was uncomfortable thinking we were going into an alehouse, but now I am decidedly more uncomfortable. Is it truly necessary for us to be here?
column2: 想到我们要进酒馆，我已经不自在了，可现在我显然更不自在。我们真的有必要待在这儿吗？

column1: I'm afraid there hasn't been a change on the waiting period. Unless you plan to stay around for a week or more, there's little I can do for you. My apologies.
column2: 恐怕等候时间没有变化。除非你打算在附近待上一周或更久，否则我帮不了你什么。抱歉。

column1: I'm not sure whether to be glad the building is getting some use, or to mourn the whiskey.
column2: 我不知道该为这栋楼有人用而高兴，还是该为那威士忌哀悼。

column1: I'm sure you'll find something you like. Do try to enjoy yourselves.
column2: 我肯定你们能找到喜欢的。就请尽情享受吧。

column1: I'm... ah... well just call me Leftie, I guess. Cuz I'm left-handed, and also it kinda leans.. well you'll see, won't you? Why the fuck am I so nervous?
column2: 我……啊……嗯，就叫我 Leftie 吧，我想。因为我是左撇子，而且它还有点歪……嗯，你自己会看见的，对吧？我他妈到底在紧张什么？

column1: I've talked to a few people, and none of the clients have ever seen Ms. Zianne. I bet it's just a cute name for a dumb pet dog or something.
column2: 我跟几个人聊过，从没有客人见过 Zianne 女士。我打赌那只是给一条蠢宠物狗起的可爱名字之类的。

column1: I... alright. I'll try.
column2: 我……好吧。我试试。

column1: If anyone asks, I am absolutely not a werewolf and I have never, ever been to Hayill. There was an incident a few years ago and we're kinda blacklisted here.
column2: 要是有人问，我绝对不是狼人，也从来、从来没去过海伊尔。几年前出过一件事，我们在这儿差不多上了黑名单。

column1: In any case, we are very popular. Our books are full well in advance. Our current waiting period to meet with someone is eight days.
column2: 总之，我们非常受欢迎。预约簿提前很久就满了。目前要见一个人，等候时间是八天。

column1: It was a bit weird at first, but really, this island is nothing but men, men, men as far as the eye can see. If you don't push your boundaries, there's no surviving this place.
column2: 一开始是有点怪，可说真的，这座岛上放眼望去全是男人、男人、男人。你要是不把自己的底线往外推一推，这地方就活不下去。

column1: It's going to take me all day to restring this harp. Thank you again for the wire.
column2: 给这把竖琴重新上弦要花我一整天。再次谢谢你的金属丝。

column1: It's not every day I get a man as strong and handsome as you, you know.
column2: 像你这么强壮、这么英俊的男人，可不是天天能遇上的，知道吧。

column1: Let the worries of the road fall away. For now, there is only this.
column2: 让路上的忧虑散去吧。眼下，只有这个。

column1: Like this Ms. Vivian?
column2: 像这样吗，Vivian 女士？

column1: Look, I'm not available. Check with the Madame if you want to make an appointment. Maybe one of the other ladies can see you.
column2: 听着，我没空。想预约就去问鸨母。也许别的姑娘能见你。

column1: Look, me and the Ettins can kick your ass if we have to. Just don't make trouble, alright? Please. It's a shit enough job as it is.
column2: 听着，有必要的话，我和那些双头巨人能把你的屁股踢开花。别惹事，行吗？求你了。这差事已经够狗屎的了。

column1: My appointments for the day are finished, so I have much time to spare. I can see you, if you like, for my standard fee. It will be 200$, and I will show you a tender hand.
column2: 我今天的预约都结束了，所以空闲很多。你要是愿意，我可以见你，按我的标准费用。200$，我会用手温柔地服侍你。

column1: My wife would kill me if she knew I was in a place like this.
column2: 我老婆要是知道我在这种地方，会杀了我的。

column1: No doubt. I can imagine what you'd ask in return for such a service as well!
column2: 那还用说。换你来做这种服务，你会要什么回报，我也能想象！

column1: No offense, Paul.
column2: 无意冒犯，Paul。

column1: No.
column2: 不。

column1: None taken. It kinda does.
column2: 没关系。还真有点儿。

column1: Not that I will ever see her again, of course. I'd like to think that she'd be understanding, but... I know she wouldn't.
column2: 当然，我也再没机会见到她了。我愿意想她会理解，可是……我知道她不会。

column1: Not too bad, hmm? I'd love to give you a bigger draught, but I gotta save something special for the full experience, hmm? Maybe make an appointment and ask for me. You won't regret it!
column2: 还行吧，嗯？我倒是想给你来更满的一大口，可我得把特别的留到完整体验，嗯？也许去预约，点我的名。你不会后悔的！

column1: Of course you have.
column2: 你当然来了。

column1: Of course... it would be kinda nice to get a massage or something wouldn't it? I have a bit of coin, so maybe I'll... oh I don't know.
column2: 当然……能按摩一下之类的，不也挺好吗？我有一点钱，所以也许我会……哦，我不知道。

column1: Oh God, I just realized, what if she's in there alone? Making that... noise?
column2: 哦，上帝，我刚意识到，万一她一个人在里面呢？发出那种……声音？

column1: Oh goodness! This might just do the trick. Here, let me give you something from my earnings.
column2: 哦，天哪！这也许正好管用。来，我从赚的钱里给你一点。

column1: Oh, I'm sorry dear. My last client really wrecked me. I'm taking the rest of the day off. I'm sure you understand.
column2: 哦，抱歉，亲爱的。上一位客人真把我折腾坏了。我今天剩下的时间要休息。我肯定你理解。

column1: Oh, come on, I don't bite. Not unless you pay me to.
column2: 哦，得了，我不咬人。除非你付钱让我咬。

column1: Oh, hey, good timing. Zip me up, would you?
column2: 哦，嘿，来得正好。帮我把拉链拉上，行吗？

column1: Oh, how fun! I love brothels! The women here always have such interesting stories, and they're usually tough as nails too! I wonder if they're all working, or if I can find someone to chat with.
column2: 哦，真有意思！我喜欢妓院！这儿的女人总有那么有趣的故事，而且通常一个个都硬气得很！不知道她们是不是都在干活，还是我能找个人聊聊。

column1: Oh, sorry. I don't see many people who aren't here for their pound of flesh. And it is a whole pound, by the way. I weighed it.\n\nMaybe come back later, hmm?
column2: 哦，抱歉。来这儿的人，我没见过几个不是冲着那一磅肉来的。顺便说一句，是整整一磅。我称过。\n\n也许过会儿再来，嗯？

column1: Oh, sure. Just slip me 500$ and give me a minute to go shave my legs, and I'll give you a ride on a wild boar. Give me a break.
column2: 哦，行啊。塞给我500$，再给我一分钟去刮腿毛，我就让你骑上一头野猪。得了吧。

column1: Oh. This isn't an alehouse at all is it? Well why wouldn't they change the name, then? Why still call it the pump-
column2: 哦。这根本不是酒馆，对吧？那他们为什么不改名字？为什么还叫它 Pump——

column1: Oh... well shit. You weren't kidding. Well... meet me in the empty room, I guess.
column2: 哦……操。你没开玩笑。那……到空房间见我吧，我想。

column1: Peregrine, for the price you'd ask, you'd need to throw in a serenade and a bottle of wine at a bare minimum!
column2: Peregrine，就你开的那个价，你至少得再附上一首小夜曲和一瓶酒！

column1: Perfect, thanks. I'd give you a handy, but my next client is going to be here any minute. Busy, busy.
column2: 完美，谢谢。我本想给你来发手活，可下一位客人随时会到。忙，忙。

column1: Perhaps I'll sit and wait while you... explore the premises. I think a fellow named Rugal wants to see you. Don't ask me how I know that.
column2: 也许我坐着等，你去……探探这地方。我觉得有个叫 Rugal 的人想见你。别问我怎么知道的。

column1: Please do not toy with me. If you cannot afford my fee, leave and make room for someone who can.
column2: 请别拿我取乐。你要是付不起我的费用，就离开，把地方让给付得起的人。

column1: Please!
column2: 求你了！

column1: Sadly, I think my harp is finished. Several of my strings have broken, and I cannot play without them. I have no idea where I'll be able to find wire delicate enough to serve as harp string. I'm afraid I cannot play for you today.
column2: 可惜，我想我的竖琴算是完了。好几根弦断了，没有它们我没法弹。我完全不知道上哪儿能找到细得能当竖琴弦的金属丝。恐怕我今天不能为你演奏。

column1: Shapiro, buddy, if you wanted someone to give you a bath, your good friend Peregrine is always happy to oblige!
column2: Shapiro，兄弟，你要是想有人给你洗澡，你的好朋友 Peregrine 随时乐意效劳！

column1: Should I rent a room for you two?
column2: 要我给你们俩租个房间吗？

column1: Smells a bit like cocks though. Roses and cocks. \n\nI guess that can't be helped.
column2: 不过有点鸡巴味。玫瑰和鸡巴。 \n\n我想这也没办法。

column1: So I'm thinking we blow all these lonely guys for half price, and then pool the money and buy the most expensive whore in the house. Great idea, right?
column2: 所以我在想，咱们半价把这些寂寞的家伙都口一遍，再把钱凑起来，买下这店里最贵的婊子。好主意，对吧？

column1: Some of these girls make like 500$ for a single fuck, and they're sore about paying me 100$ and a crust of bread for a whole day. It's bullshit.
column2: 有些姑娘操一次就能赚差不多500$，付我一整天100$加一块面包皮却心疼得要命。放屁。

column1: Sorry Vankan, I'm asking. How do you know Rugal?
column2: 抱歉，Vankan，我就是要问。你怎么认识 Rugal？

column1: Sorry, I'm just exhausted. I don't mean to be rude, but I need to rest.
column2: 抱歉，我只是累坏了。我不是有意无礼，可我需要休息。

column1: Sorry, what? I was distracted by the stunning floral arrangements. Now, where do you think the bar is?
column2: 抱歉，你说什么？我被那些美得惊人的插花分了神。那么，你觉得酒吧在哪儿？

column1: Thanks, huh? Feels good to be worth something for once, even if it's just worth a handful of coins.\n\nBack to the crap job, though. Seeya later.
column2: 谢了，是吧？总算有一回觉得自己还值点什么，哪怕就值一把硬币。\n\n不过还是得回去干那份烂差事。回头见。

column1: That older guy has been looking at me strangely for the last little while. Did I take his seat or something?
column2: 那个年纪大些的家伙刚才一直怪怪地看着我。是我占了他的位子，还是怎么的？

column1: That's not true. You're so beautiful and I'm just a dumb scrub.
column2: 才不是。你那么美，我只是个又蠢又窝囊的废物。

column1: The same way I know how you know Rugal. I just do.
column2: 跟我知道你怎么认识 Rugal 是一个道理。我就是知道。

column1: The waiting lists here are absurd! I had to book my appointment a week in advance and I still have to wait!
column2: 这儿的等候名单荒谬极了！我提前一周就约好了，到现在还得等！

column1: Then leave me alone. I have to keep an eye on all these poor sots in case one of them succumbs to boner rage.
column2: 那就把我一个人留下。我得盯着这些可怜的倒霉蛋，免得哪个硬到发狂。

column1: There are too many people here, all eyeing each other like fish at market. I don't like it.
column2: 这儿人太多了，一个个互相打量，跟菜市上的鱼似的。我不喜欢。

column1: There we go. Found your spot, didn't I?
column2: 好了。找着你的点了，是不是？

column1: There's quite a few of us here, as you can see. I been waiting for hours already.
column2: 你也看见了，我们这儿人还不少。我已经等了好几个小时了。

column1: There, now we got that out of the way, you just huck your clothes and get comfortable, hmm? You're gonna enjoy this.
column2: 好了，这事了结了，你把衣服一甩，放松就行，嗯？你会享受的。

column1: They're always booked solid here. Last time I was here, I ended up taking an appointment with Rugal because he was the only one available.
column2: 这儿永远约得满满的。上次我来，最后跟 Rugal 约了，因为他是唯一有空的。

column1: This is a pretty nice place. They must've worked hard to keep it in such good condition.
column2: 这地方挺不错。他们肯定费了不少力气，才把它维持得这么好。

column1: This place smells like the cheese from a giant's cockskin.
column2: 这地方闻起来像巨人的包皮垢。

column1: Too long? That's a pity. Do feel free to have a look around, though. Maybe you'll decide that it would be worth the wait after all.
column2: 太久了？真遗憾。不过请随意四处看看。也许你会觉得，等一等终究是值得的。

column1: Welcome to the Pumphouse, strangers.
column2: 欢迎来到泵房，陌生人。

column1: Well hello again, darling.
column2: 哟，又见面了，亲爱的。

column1: Well hello again, sailor.
column2: 哟，又见面了，水手。

column1: Well shit, that sounds like way more fun than sticking around here. If you want me along, I'll just go get my things! Come find me when you're ready to go.
column2: 操，这听起来比继续待在这儿有意思多了。你要是想带上我，我这就去拿东西！准备好走了就来找我。

column1: Well you're an asshole. But thanks for the laugh anyway.
column2: 你就是个混蛋。不过还是谢你逗我笑了。

column1: Well, ain't that great? The door fee is 200$. You want in, you pay up.
column2: 嗯，可真好啊？入场费200$。想进就交钱。
